title.zh-TW: 打開資料夾與對話時會先提醒 hook 狀況
title.en: Hook warnings when opening folders or conversations

body.zh-TW:
打開陌生資料夾，你怎麼確定裡面沒有藏著會自動執行的腳本？進到信任確認畫面時，現在會直接寫明這個資料夾的 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）宣告在哪裡。

如果你在 Claude Desktop 或其他非互動式環境工作，遇到管理設定裡的 hook 載入失敗，對話裡也會直接跳出警告通知你。

⟦像進租屋處簽約前，房東把電錶箱與門鎖開關標得清清楚楚，哪條線路上不了電也會貼條通知，不用等你搬進去才自己摸黑猜。⟧
body.en:
When you open an unfamiliar folder, how can you tell there aren't any hidden scripts that run on their own? The trust dialog now spells out where that folder's hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) are declared.

If you are working in Claude Desktop or another non-interactive host and hooks in managed settings fail to load, a warning now appears right in the conversation.

⟦Picture walking through a rental before signing the lease: the landlord clearly labels the breaker box and door locks, and tapes a note on any circuit that cannot power on, so you are not left guessing in the dark after moving in.⟧

items.original:
Added a trust dialog warning that says where a folder's hooks are declared
Added a warning in the conversation, in Claude Desktop and other non-interactive hosts, when hooks in managed settings fail to load

title.zh-TW: /tasks 納管排程並統一背景任務計數
title.en: /tasks adds scheduled tasks and unifies background counts

body.zh-TW:
對話跑著跑著，背景常同時掛著定時提醒與各類執行項目，以前總散在不同角落。輸入 `/tasks` 後，清單現在會把目前工作階段的排程任務、`/loop` 喚醒項目、目標以及對話分岔全部列進來，選中某項按 `x` 確認後就能停掉它。

清單標題與底部背景計數已整合成單一數字。裡面包含終端機指令、監控腳本、MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）呼叫、代理、工作流與排程任務。

⟦如同機場把登機門廣播、行李轉盤與接駁車動態收進同一面出發總表，抬頭掃一眼總數，想取消哪一班也能當場抽單。⟧
body.en:
As a conversation runs, timed reminders and various background runs often pile up in different places. When you enter `/tasks`, the list now includes this session's scheduled tasks, `/loop` wakeups, the goal, and this conversation's forks, and you can select an item and press `x` to stop it after confirming.

The list header and the footer's background count now show a single combined number. It covers shells, monitor scripts, MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) calls, agents, workflows, and scheduled tasks.

⟦Think of an airport pulling gate announcements, baggage carousels, and shuttle statuses onto one departures board: you can see the total at a glance and pull a flight from the board on the spot.⟧

items.original:
Added this session's scheduled tasks, `/loop` wakeups, the goal and this conversation's forks to `/tasks`; x stops one after asking
Changed the `/tasks` header and the footer's background count to one number covering shells, monitors, MCP calls, agents, workflows and scheduled tasks

title.zh-TW: 排程任務在重開與離開時的執行規則調整
title.en: Updated rules for scheduled tasks on reopen and exit

body.zh-TW:
更新後重開新的登入工作階段，舊版存下來的排程任務多半需要重新設定排程。不過如果你用 `--resume` 接回原本的工作階段，它們還是會照常跑。

選用「Exit and stop tasks」時，現在會真正結束這個工作階段的排程任務，下次恢復對話時不會再自己啟動。唯一例外是你在 Claude 還在回覆時就離開，任務才不會被停掉。

⟦跟鬧鐘改版一樣，另開一個已登入的新工作階段得重新勾選提醒時段，但接回舊時光軸依然會響；親手按掉「離開並停止任務」後，下次翻開紀錄也不會再突然鈴聲大作。⟧
body.en:
After updating, if you start a new signed-in session, most scheduled tasks saved by earlier versions will need to be scheduled again. However, if you use `--resume` to return to their original session, they will still run as usual.

Choosing "Exit and stop tasks" now actually ends this session's scheduled tasks so they do not start on their own next time you resume the conversation. The only exception is if you exit while Claude is still responding, in which case the tasks are not stopped.

⟦Like updating an alarm app, opening a new signed-in session means re-checking your reminder times, though jumping back onto the old timeline still rings them; once you tap "Exit and stop tasks" yourself, reopening the log later will not set off unexpected alarms either.⟧

items.original:
Changed saved scheduled tasks: in new signed-in sessions, most saved by earlier versions need scheduling again, though `--resume` of their own session still runs them
Changed 'Exit and stop tasks' to end this session's scheduled tasks so they don't run again on resume, unless you exit while Claude is responding

title.zh-TW: Stop 掛鉤改將監控腳本標為 monitor
title.en: Stop hooks now label monitor scripts as monitor

body.zh-TW: 給有設定 `Stop` 與 `SubagentStop` hook 的使用者或開發者，這裡有個分類調整。當你的腳本讀取背景任務清單時，由 Monitor 執行的腳本現在會標成 `monitor`，不再歸類成 `shell`。
body.en: For users or developers with `Stop` and `SubagentStop` hooks configured, there is a classification change. When your script reads the background tasks list, scripts run by a Monitor are now labeled `monitor` instead of `shell`.

items.original: Changed Stop and SubagentStop hooks to list a Monitor's script as `monitor`, not `shell`, in `background_tasks`

title.zh-TW: /mcp 顯示連線拒絕訊息並修正 410 誤判
title.en: /mcp shows connection refusal messages and fixes 410 mislabeling

body.zh-TW:
遠端 HTTP MCP 伺服器拒絕連線時，以前畫面常只給一個冷冰冰的失敗結果，搞不清對方擋在哪。現在打開 `/mcp` 裡該伺服器的頁面，會多出一行「Server message」，直接把遠端回傳的 JSON-RPC 錯誤訊息攤給你看。

用 `claude mcp login` 或 `/mcp` 登入時，若對方的用戶端註冊已經停用並回傳 `HTTP 410 Gone`，畫面也不會再誤判成該服務不接受從 Claude Code 登入。

⟦好比打客服專線被掛斷時，電話不再只響忙音或誤報「門號禁止撥打」，而是直接播報對方總機寫好的故障原因，讓你立刻知道是哪一關擋下來。⟧
body.en:
When a remote HTTP MCP server refuses a connection, the screen used to show only a cold failure notice without explaining where it got blocked. Now, opening that server's page in `/mcp` includes a "Server message" row that displays the JSON-RPC error message returned by the remote server.

When signing in with `claude mcp login` or `/mcp`, if the other side's client registration has been retired and returns `HTTP 410 Gone`, the screen will no longer mistakenly report that the service does not accept sign-ins from Claude Code.

⟦Imagine calling a support hotline and getting disconnected: instead of just hearing a busy tone or a false "number not permitted" error, the line plays the exact fault reason written by the other side's switchboard so you know right away which step blocked you.⟧

items.original:
Added a "Server message" row to a server's page in `/mcp` that shows the JSON-RPC error message of a remote HTTP MCP server that refuses the connection
Fixed `claude mcp login` and `/mcp` saying a service doesn't accept sign-ins from Claude Code when the service's client registration had been retired (HTTP 410 Gone)

title.zh-TW: MCP 驗證、重連與工具載入的四項修復
title.en: Four fixes for MCP auth, reconnects, and tool loading

body.zh-TW:
連接外部工具最怕遇上斷線或驗證打架，這幾項異常狀態現在穩多了。

剛清除某台 MCP 伺服器的登入驗證，剛好撞上背景正在更新 token（授權令牌）時，伺服器不會再莫名其妙又自動登入回來。

背景的 MCP 任務在慢速重連後不再卡死。只要遠端 HTTP MCP 伺服器停留在較舊的協定版本，Claude Code 現在會自己幫大多數這類伺服器重新連線。

開啟工具搜尋的工作階段裡，已連上的 MCP 伺服器若工具載入失敗，Claude 現在會收到明確告知，不再誤以為它沒有任何工具。

同一網址的其他外掛或 MCP 伺服器連線失敗時，Claude Docs 連接器的工具不會跟著消失，錯誤提示也不會再亂叫你去執行 `/login`。
body.en:
Connecting to external tools is hardest when disconnects or auth conflicts hit, and several of those edge cases are now much more stable.

If you clear an MCP server's sign-in authentication right as a background token (authorization credential) refresh is running, the server will no longer mysteriously sign itself back in.

Background MCP tasks no longer stall after a slow reconnect. When a remote HTTP MCP server stays on an older protocol version, Claude Code now reconnects most of those servers on its own.

In sessions with tool search enabled, if a connected MCP server fails to load its tools, Claude is now explicitly told instead of assuming the server has no tools.

When another plugin or MCP server at the same address fails to connect, the Claude Docs connector's tools no longer disappear along with it, and the error prompt no longer wrongly tells you to run `/login`.

items.original:
Fixed an MCP server being signed in again after you cleared its authentication while a token refresh was running
Fixed background MCP tasks that stalled after a slow reconnect: Claude Code now reconnects most HTTP MCP servers by itself when one is left on an older protocol version
Fixed Claude not being told that a connected MCP server's tools could not be loaded, and taking it for a server with no tools, in sessions with tool search
Fixed the Claude Docs connector's tools going missing when a plugin or MCP server at the same address failed to connect, and its error wrongly suggesting `/login`

title.zh-TW: 修正檔案收存變 .bin 與首次傳檔失敗
title.en: Fixed files saved as .bin and first-try file send failures

body.zh-TW:
從 MCP 伺服器或網站傳來的 PDF、圖片，以及 `.docx`、`.xlsx`、`.pptx` 檔案，有時會以 `application/octet-stream` 格式送出。過去這類檔案會被存成 `.bin`，導致 Claude 讀不到 PDF 與圖片，現在已經修好。

使用 Opus 4.8 與 Opus 5 請 Claude 傳檔案給你時，第一次傳檔偶爾失敗的狀況也修好了，不用再請它重傳一次。
body.en:
PDFs, images, and `.docx`, `.xlsx`, and `.pptx` files sent from MCP servers or websites sometimes arrive as `application/octet-stream`. Previously, those files were saved as `.bin`, preventing Claude from reading the PDFs and images; that is now fixed.

When asking Claude to send you a file on Opus 4.8 and Opus 5, occasional failures on the first attempt are also fixed, so you no longer need to ask it to resend.

items.original:
Fixed PDFs, images and `.docx`, `.xlsx` or `.pptx` files that MCP servers or websites send as `application/octet-stream` being saved as .bin, which kept Claude from reading the PDFs and images
Fixed Claude sometimes failing to send you a file on its first try on Opus 4.8 and Opus 5

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 啟用條件放寬與停用方式調整
title.en: Relaxed Code Mode startup conditions and disable controls

body.zh-TW:
想讓 Claude 自己寫腳本串接工具來跑的 Code Mode，過去遇到監控或特定模組就會被默默關掉。現在就算開啟 OpenTelemetry 事件與指標，Code Mode 也能啟用，腳本裡每次呼叫工具都會送出事件；只有開啟追蹤功能時仍會維持關閉。

就算關掉了遙測、非必要流量或功能旗標，Code Mode 一樣能啟動。如果管理員想明確停用，改由受管理的設定檔去關閉即可。

只列出部分工具的模組，也不會再悄悄把 Code Mode 關掉，想停用同樣要靠管理員設定控制。

⟦打個比方，以前天文台只要氣象感測沒全接上就不開圓頂，現在就算拔掉幾條回報線也能觀星，真的不想開放得由館長親手下鎖。⟧
body.en:
Code Mode, which lets Claude write its own scripts to chain tools together, used to be silently turned off when monitoring or certain mods were active. Now Code Mode can stay on even when OpenTelemetry events and metrics are enabled, and each tool call in a script sends its events; only tracing still keeps it off.

Code Mode can also start when telemetry, nonessential traffic, or feature flags are turned off. If an administrator wants to explicitly keep it off, they can disable it in managed settings instead.

Mods that list only some tools will no longer silently turn Code Mode off either; disabling it likewise requires administrator settings.

⟦An observatory used to keep its dome shut whenever a single weather sensor was unplugged, whereas now it still opens for stargazing with a few reporting lines disconnected—keeping it closed takes the director locking it by hand.⟧

items.original:
Added support for turning on Code Mode while OpenTelemetry events and metrics are enabled; each tool call the code makes sends its events; tracing still keeps it off
Changed Code Mode to also start when telemetry, nonessential traffic or feature flags are turned off; an administrator can keep it off in managed settings
Fixed mods that list only some tools silently turning Code Mode off; such a mod no longer keeps it off, so use managed settings for that

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 腳本限制與掛鉤行為對齊一般模式
title.en: Code Mode script rules and hook behavior match standard mode

body.zh-TW:
寫進 Code Mode 腳本裡的規則，現在跟一般對話操作越來越一致了。PreToolUse hook 如果出錯，不再直接擋下腳本裡的工具呼叫，跟一般模式相同。若在指令、HTTP 或 MCP 工具的 hook 上遇到失敗必須擋下，請加上 `"onFailure": "block"`。

腳本內如果自己宣告了 `log`、`preview` 或 `sleep` 這幾個名稱，以前會被直接拒跑，現在可以正常執行。

在 Code Mode 裡啟動子代理後，Claude 收到的等待指引也跟一般模式看齊，不再各走各的規則。

⟦換成考場來看，內外原本各有兩套作答規矩，現在把錯題不倒扣、可用字詞跟交卷等待方式全對齊，真要嚴格擋下再另外標記。⟧
body.en:
Rules for Code Mode scripts are becoming more consistent with regular conversation behavior. If a PreToolUse hook errors, it no longer blocks the script's tool call, matching regular mode. If a failure on a command, HTTP, or MCP tool hook must block execution, add `"onFailure": "block"`.

Scripts that declare their own `log`, `preview`, or `sleep` names used to be refused outright, and now run normally.

After starting a subagent in Code Mode, Claude now receives the same waiting guidance as in regular mode instead of following separate rules.

⟦Previously, the exam hall enforced one set of rules inside and another outside, but now no-penalty errors, allowed terms, and turn-in waiting rules are all aligned, with strict blocks marked separately.⟧

items.original:
Changed Code Mode so a PreToolUse hook that errors no longer refuses a script's tool call, as outside Code Mode; set `"onFailure": "block"` on a command, HTTP or MCP tool hook that must refuse
Changed Code Mode to run a script that declares its own `log`, `preview` or `sleep`, which it used to refuse
Improved Code Mode: after starting a subagent, Claude now gets the same guidance on waiting as outside Code Mode

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 記憶體控管與大檔讀取上限
title.en: Code Mode memory controls and large-file read limits

body.zh-TW:
讓 Code Mode 處理大檔案或跑長腳本，電腦比較不容易被拖垮。

腳本陷入無止境迴圈時，現在會在達到上限後自動停下，不再把整台機器的記憶體塞爆。

讀過的大型文字檔不再全部留駐在記憶體裡，背景子代理每次被喚醒時記憶體也不會持續膨脹。

腳本一次嘗試讀取超過 256 MiB 的行數範圍會被直接拒絕，避免吃掉幾 GB 的記憶體；讀取超長單行時逾時的問題也修好了。

當腳本執行上千次工具呼叫後，終端機畫面卡住不動的時間也縮短很多。
body.en:
Having Code Mode process large files or run long scripts is now much less likely to bog down your computer.

When a script gets stuck in a runaway loop, it now stops automatically at a limit instead of filling up the entire machine's memory.

Large text files that have been read are no longer all kept in memory, and memory no longer keeps growing each time a background subagent is woken.

If a script tries to read a line range over 256 MiB at once, it is now refused to avoid using gigabytes of memory; timeouts when reading very long single lines are also fixed.

After a script makes thousands of tool calls, the terminal freezes for far less time.

items.original:
Fixed a runaway loop in Code Mode filling the machine's memory; it is now stopped at a limit
Fixed Code Mode keeping in memory every large text file that code read, and memory growing each time a background subagent was woken
Improved Code Mode: the terminal freezes for far less time after a script makes thousands of tool calls
Changed Code Mode to refuse a script's read of a line range over 256 MiB, which could use gigabytes of memory, and fixed reads of very long lines timing out

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 呼叫 MCP 工具的等待與結束修復
title.en: Fixes for Waiting and Ending in Code Mode MCP Calls

body.zh-TW:
在 Code Mode 腳本裡呼叫 MCP 工具等回應，過去可能在等待期間被停止，或直接無視工具訊號。

腳本等待 MCP 表單、連結提示或每次必問的提示回答期間，不會再因十分鐘上限而被停止。

大多數超過 2 分鐘的 MCP 呼叫，不再把「移到背景執行」這句話當成資料塞回給腳本。腳本現在最多會等到 10 分鐘，超過才回報錯誤。

當 Claude 等待腳本執行期間，若裡面的 MCP 工具要求結束這一輪對話，Code Mode 現在會照辦，不再忽視這個訊號。
body.en:
When a Code Mode script called an MCP tool and waited for a response, it could previously be stopped while waiting or ignore the tool's signal.

A script waiting for an answer to an MCP form, an MCP link prompt, or a prompt that always asks is no longer stopped at the ten-minute limit.

Most MCP calls over 2 minutes no longer pass a "moved to the background" message back to the script as data. The script now waits up to 10 minutes before reporting an error.

When an MCP tool called from a script that Claude is waiting on asks to end the turn, Code Mode now honors that request instead of ignoring the signal.

items.original:
Fixed Code Mode stopping a script at its ten-minute limit while an MCP form, an MCP link prompt or a prompt that always asks was waiting for an answer
Fixed Code Mode scripts receiving a "moved to the background" message as data from most MCP calls over two minutes: the script now waits up to ten minutes, then gets an error
Fixed Code Mode ignoring an MCP tool's request to end the turn when the tool was called from a script that Claude waits for

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 腳本變數、參數與中斷顯示修復
title.en: Fixes for Code Mode Script Variables, Arguments, and Interrupts

body.zh-TW:
在 Code Mode 寫腳本並按 Esc 中斷，以前容易遇到幾個摸不著頭緒的毛病。

按 Esc 中斷後，腳本已經完成的編輯與被停下的指令不再躲起來，離開時也不會一併消失。

新腳本宣告 `let x;` 時，終於會是個乾淨的變數，不會偷留前一段腳本塞給 `x` 的舊值。

呼叫本來就不需要參數的工具時，不傳引數過去也不會再錯報「缺少參數」。

當工作階段裡掛了超過 4,096 個工具時，腳本透過 `tools` 依然找得到所有工具，不會半路失去存取權。
body.en:
Writing scripts in Code Mode and interrupting them with Esc used to trigger several puzzling issues.

After pressing Esc, finished edits and the stopped command from a script no longer stay hidden or disappear on exit.

When a new script declares `let x;`, it now starts clean instead of keeping the old value an earlier script gave `x`.

Calling a tool that needs no parameters without arguments no longer fails with a missing-parameter error.

When a session has more than 4,096 tools, scripts still find every tool through `tools` instead of losing access partway through.

items.original:
Fixed Code Mode hiding a script's finished edits and the stopped command after Esc, and losing them on exit
Fixed a Code Mode script's `let x;` keeping the value that an earlier script gave `x`
Fixed a Code Mode script's call with no argument failing with a missing-parameter error on tools that need none
Fixed Code Mode scripts losing access to tools through `tools` in sessions with more than 4,096 tools

title.zh-TW: 修正網路卡頓導致 ~/.claude.json 遭重置
title.en: Fix for ~/.claude.json Resetting During Network Stalls

body.zh-TW: 以前萬一遇到網路卡頓或檔案被鎖住，讓 `~/.claude.json` 一時讀不到，存檔時整個設定檔就可能被清空重設回預設值。這個問題已經修好，你的設定不會再無故被洗白。
body.en: Previously, if a network stall or file lock made `~/.claude.json` temporarily unreadable, saving could clear the entire configuration file and reset it to defaults. That issue is now fixed, so your settings will no longer be wiped for no reason.

items.original: Fixed `~/.claude.json` sometimes being reset to defaults when a network stall or file lock made it unreadable and cleared during a save

title.zh-TW: macOS 鑰匙圈無法寫入時的登入與診斷調整
title.en: Login and Diagnostic Adjustments for Read-Only macOS Keychain

body.zh-TW:
在 Mac 上如果 Claude Code 讀得到鑰匙圈卻寫不進去，以前常會把你反覆登出。現在更新登入憑證時會改用名為 `Claude Code-write-check` 的項目測試寫入權限。真的寫不進去時，只會讓目前這個工作階段在憑證到期時停下並說明原因，其他工作階段會繼續保持登入。

在 macOS 沙盒環境裡執行 `claude doctor` 時，也不會再誤建議你解鎖鑰匙圈，因為在沙盒裡解鎖根本幫不上忙。

⟦像員工打卡鐘一時只能讀紀錄卻寫不進新班別，其他樓層的門禁不受影響，只有剛好到期的那張證件會亮燈說明停卡原因，管理室也不再叫你重設鎖死的分機。⟧
body.en:
On a Mac, when Claude Code could read the Keychain but not write to it, it used to sign you out repeatedly. Now, renewing login credentials tests write access using an item named `Claude Code-write-check`. If writing actually fails, only the current session stops at credential expiry and explains why, while other sessions stay signed in.

Running `claude doctor` inside a macOS sandbox also stops mistakenly advising you to open the locked Keychain, since doing so cannot help inside a sandbox.

⟦A time clock can read punch records for a moment yet cannot write new shifts: access on other floors stays untouched, only the badge that happens to expire lights up to explain why it stopped, and the front desk stops telling you to reset a locked extension.⟧

items.original:
Fixed repeated sign-outs on macOS when Claude Code could read the Keychain but not save to it. That session now stops at expiry and says why, and other sessions stay signed in
Changed macOS login renewal to test the Keychain with a `Claude Code-write-check` item
Fixed `claude doctor` advising a Keychain unlock inside a macOS sandbox, where unlocking can't help

title.zh-TW: /terminal-setup 與自訂快捷鍵修復
title.en: Fixes for /terminal-setup and Custom Keybindings

body.zh-TW:
操作表單、查看按鍵提示，或請它設定終端機與編輯器，現在不會再出錯或失靈。

跑 `/terminal-setup` 改 VS Code 設定或 `keybindings.json`，不再破壞區塊註解附近內容，有未閉合字串也不會漏掉 Shift+Enter 綁定卻回報成功。

在 macOS 27 的 Terminal.app，不再開啟「Use Option as Meta key」，提示也不再把 Shift+Enter 寫成 Option+Enter。

權限確認、提問、`/model` 與 `/rewind` 提示，都改照 `keybindings.json` 顯示。

自訂取消鍵在 `/add-dir`、`/tui` 回饋與儲存工作流表單都有效；在該表單按方向鍵不再移動背後游標。
body.en:
Working with forms, checking key hints, or having Claude configure your terminal and editor will no longer break or fail.

Running `/terminal-setup` to update VS Code settings or `keybindings.json` no longer corrupts content around block comments, and an unclosed string no longer drops the Shift+Enter binding while reporting success.

In Terminal.app on macOS 27, it no longer turns on "Use Option as Meta key", and tips no longer suggest Option+Enter instead of Shift+Enter.

Key hints in permission prompts, questions, `/model`, and `/rewind` now follow `keybindings.json`.

A custom cancel key now works in `/add-dir`, `/tui` feedback, and the save-workflow form; pressing arrow keys in that form no longer moves the cursor behind it.

items.original:
Fixed `/terminal-setup` corrupting VS Code settings or keybindings files around block comments, and reporting success while losing the Shift+Enter binding where keybindings.json has an unclosed string
Fixed `/terminal-setup` turning on "Use Option as Meta key" in Terminal.app on macOS 27, and tips there suggesting Option+Enter instead of Shift+Enter
Fixed key hints in permission prompts, questions, `/model` and `/rewind` ignoring `keybindings.json`
Fixed a custom cancel key not working in `/add-dir`, `/tui` feedback and the save-workflow form
Fixed arrow keys in the save-workflow form moving the selection in the workflow view behind it

title.zh-TW: 修正 IDE 差異存檔遺失換行與 BOM 標記
title.en: Fix for Missing Final Newlines and BOM in IDE Diffs

body.zh-TW: 在 IDE 差異比對畫面點選接受修改，過去存檔後常少掉檔案最後一個換行符號。在 VS Code 直接儲存差異檔，甚至會弄丟開頭的位元組順序記號 BOM，這兩個問題都已修好。
body.en: When you accepted edits in the IDE diff view, saved files used to lose their final newline. Saving a diff directly in VS Code could even drop the leading byte order mark (BOM); both issues are now fixed.

items.original: Fixed files accepted through the IDE diff being saved without their last newline, and losing their byte order mark (BOM) when an edit was accepted by saving the diff in VS Code

title.zh-TW: 修正 /teleport 挑選雲端對話覆蓋目前紀錄
title.en: Fix for /teleport Overwriting the Current Conversation

body.zh-TW: 在 `/teleport` 挑選雲端工作階段時，以前會直接把你眼前正在聊的對話蓋掉。這個問題已經修好，現在選取後會像輸入 `/clear` 一樣開出一個新工作階段，想找回原本的對話只要打 `/resume` 就回得來。
body.en: Picking a cloud session in `/teleport` used to overwrite the conversation you were currently in. That is now fixed: selecting one starts a new session just like `/clear`, and you can bring your old conversation back anytime with `/resume`.

items.original: Fixed picking a cloud session in `/teleport` replacing your open conversation: the pick now starts a new session, as `/clear` does, and `/resume` brings the old one back

title.zh-TW: 額度點數、消費上限與 /passes 顯示修復
title.en: Fixes for Usage Credits, Spend Limits, and /passes Display

body.zh-TW:
查看額度或調整消費上限，以前可能遇到重複登入或提示與實際狀態不符。

Pro 與 Max 用戶開 `/usage-credits` 打開瀏覽器後，不再被要求重新登入。若瀏覽器沒開起來且任務因點數暫停，連結也不會在 8 秒後就消失。

使用點數用完或達到每月上限時，`/usage` 不再誤報點數功能已關閉。每月上限擋住使用點數運作的模型時，`/model` 會提醒 Pro 與 Max 用戶。

消費上限選單不再把目前花費錯印成每月上限，視窗較窄時選項也不會折行壓到滑鼠游標底下。

`/passes` 在伺服器出錯後不再顯示錯誤的訪客券數量，沒剩訪客券時也不再提示分享可得使用點數。
body.en:
Checking your usage credits or adjusting spend limits could previously trigger repeated logins or show prompts that did not match the actual state.

Pro and Max users opening the browser from `/usage-credits` are no longer asked to log in again. If the browser fails to open and a task pauses for usage credits, the link no longer disappears after 8 seconds.

When usage credits run out or hit the monthly limit, `/usage` no longer falsely reports that usage credits are off. When the monthly limit blocks a model that runs on usage credits, `/model` now notifies Pro and Max users.

The spend limit menu no longer displays your current spend as your monthly limit, and in narrow windows its rows no longer wrap under the mouse pointer.

`/passes` no longer shows the wrong number of guest passes after a server error, and it stops offering usage credits for sharing when no guest passes remain.

items.original:
Fixed `/usage-credits` asking Pro and Max users to log in again after opening the browser, and the link disappearing after 8 seconds if the browser doesn't open and a task stops for usage credits
Fixed `/usage` saying usage credits are off when they had run out or reached the monthly limit, and `/model` not telling Pro and Max users when that limit blocks a model that runs on usage credits
Fixed the spend limit menu showing your spend as your monthly limit and wrapping its rows under the pointer in narrow windows
Fixed `/passes` showing the wrong number of passes after a server error, and offering usage credits for sharing when no guest passes are left

title.zh-TW: 修正 /config 開關連動與狀態列卡死
title.en: Fixes for /config Toggles and Status Line Freezes

body.zh-TW:
在設定畫面切開關或自訂終端機底部工具，介面反應與回饋都修正了。

若你自己寫的 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）腳本停不下來一直印出內容，現在不會再把輸入列卡死並吃掉好幾 GB 記憶體。

在正在跑的工作階段裡改 `/config` 開關時，自動捲動、PR 狀態徽章、自動壓縮警告與 ultracode 標籤現在都會跟著即時切換。

在 `/config` 一次改了好幾個設定後，畫面也不再安靜沒反應或只冷冷回一句「dismissed」。
body.en:
Toggling settings or customizing the bar at the bottom of your terminal now gives proper UI responsiveness and feedback.

If a custom status line (the bar shown at the bottom of your terminal) script prints endlessly without stopping, it no longer freezes the input prompt and consumes gigabytes of memory.

Changing `/config` switches in a running session now updates auto-scroll, the PR status badge, the auto-compact warning, and the ultracode tag right away.

After changing several settings at once in `/config`, the screen no longer stays silent or just replies "dismissed".

items.original:
Fixed a status line script that prints without end freezing the prompt and using gigabytes of memory
Fixed auto-scroll, the PR status badge, the auto-compact warning and the ultracode tag not following the `/config` switches that control them in a running session
Fixed `/config` saying nothing, or "dismissed", after changing many settings

title.zh-TW: /status 顯示市集更新狀態與模型細節
title.en: /status Shows Marketplace Updates and Model Details

body.zh-TW:
想知道目前套了哪個模型、又有哪些市集沒在自動更新嗎？輸入 `/status` 後，畫面新增了「Marketplace auto-update」一欄，直接點名不會自動更新的受管理市集並說明原因。

規劃模式下跑 `/status` 時，現在也會明確寫出 `opusplan` 與 `haiku` 各自實際使用的模型名稱。

在 `/model` 選單裡，如果 Default 那一列本來就顯示你儲存的模型，點選它時不再被組織的預設模型覆蓋。

⟦看懂這點就像翻手機電信帳單，明細表現在會直接寫清哪項服務沒開自動續約、目前實際跑哪套網路方案，選回預設也不會偷換成團體合約。⟧
body.en:
Want to know which model is active and which marketplaces are not auto-updating? Running `/status` now includes a "Marketplace auto-update" row that names managed marketplaces getting no automatic updates and explains why.

When you run `/status` in plan mode, it also explicitly names the actual models used by `opusplan` and `haiku`.

In the `/model` menu, when the Default row already shows your saved model, selecting it no longer overwrites it with your organization's default model.

⟦Reading this feels like checking a mobile carrier bill where the breakdown now spells out which service has auto-renew turned off and which data plan is actually running, and picking the default option no longer swaps you into a group contract.⟧

items.original:
Added a "Marketplace auto-update" row to `/status` that names managed marketplaces that get no automatic updates, and why
Fixed choosing Default in `/model` replacing your saved model with your organization's default when the Default row already showed your saved model
Fixed `/status` not naming the model that opusplan and haiku use in plan mode

title.zh-TW: /code-review 比對與結果顯示修正
title.en: Fixes for /code-review diffs and findings display

body.zh-TW:
請 Claude 用 `/code-review` 幫忙檢查程式碼，過去常審錯分支，或莫名卡在不存在的檔案權限。

不帶目標時，多數模型改把整條分支跟預設分支比對，並修好跨多筆提交漏掉差異。

指定 `/code-review <pr number>` 會改用 `gh pr diff` 讀該 PR，不再默默審本地分支。讀不到會說明。

帶 `--fix` 的 PR 編號形式，或提供 PR 網址時，若 `gh pr diff` 失敗或被拒，會直接停止審查。

多數模型不再為不存在的 `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` 跳權限確認，結果卡片也不再把中等審查標成「high」。
body.en:
Asking Claude to check code with `/code-review` used to review the wrong branch or get stuck on permissions for a missing file.

With no target, most models now compare the whole branch against the default branch and no longer lose diffs across multiple commits.

Passing `/code-review <pr number>` now reads that pull request with `gh pr diff` instead of silently reviewing the local branch. It says so when it cannot read it.

When using the PR number form with `--fix` or providing a pull request URL, the review now stops immediately if `gh pr diff` is refused or fails.

Most models no longer show a permission prompt for a missing `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, and the findings card no longer labels a medium review as "high".

items.original:
Fixed `/code-review <pr number>` sometimes reviewing the checked-out branch instead of the pull request without saying so: it now reads the pull request with `gh pr diff`, or says when it can't
Fixed `/code-review` stopping at a permission prompt, on most models, to look for a `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` that doesn't exist
Fixed the `/code-review` findings card often showing "high" for a review that ran at medium, on most models
Changed `/code-review` with no target on most models to review the whole branch against the default branch, and fixed it losing the diff on multi-commit branches
Changed `/code-review <pr number> --fix`, and `/code-review` given a pull request URL, to stop without reviewing when `gh pr diff` is refused or fails

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器修正 Git LFS、SSH 與啟動誤判
title.en: Self-hosted runner fixes for Git LFS, SSH, and startup

body.zh-TW:
在 Self-hosted runner（自架執行器）環境跑工作階段，Git 倉庫設定與連線問題少了很多。

加上 `--push-outcome-on-release` 時，不再偶爾誤刪遠端 Git 主機上該工作階段的分支。

透過 Anthropic 託管 Git 複製 Git LFS 倉庫時，工作階段準備失敗的問題已修好。工作階段會先從指標檔啟動，需要實際內容時再執行 `git lfs pull` 抓下來。

遠端網址若使用 SSH 主機別名、GitHub SSH 憑證或 GHE.com SSH 使用者，現在都能順利啟動。遇到無法解析的別名時，錯誤訊息還會直接附上兩個 git 指令。

遇上逾時或網路錯誤後，遠端 MCP 伺服器不再停在無工具或 HTTPS 斷線狀態；Claude Code 還在啟動期間，也不再被誤顯示成沒有回應。
body.en:
Running sessions in a self-hosted runner environment now has far fewer Git repository setup and connection issues.

Using `--push-outcome-on-release` no longer occasionally deletes the session's branch on the remote Git host.

Session setup no longer fails on Git LFS repositories cloned through Anthropic-managed Git. Sessions now start from pointer files and run `git lfs pull` when the actual content is needed.

Sessions now start cleanly from remotes using an SSH host alias, GitHub SSH certificates, or a GHE.com SSH user. When an alias cannot be resolved, the error message includes two git commands directly.

After a timeout or network error, remote MCP servers no longer stay without tools or disconnected over HTTPS, and Claude Code is no longer shown as unresponsive while still starting.

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Fixed `--push-outcome-on-release` sometimes deleting a session's branch on the git host
Self-hosted runner: Fixed setup failing on Git LFS repositories cloned through Anthropic-managed git; sessions now start on pointer files, and `git lfs pull` fetches the content
Fixed sessions on self-hosted environments not starting from a git remote with an SSH host alias, GitHub SSH certificates or a GHE.com SSH user; an unresolved alias's error gives two git commands
Fixed remote MCP servers in self-hosted runner sessions staying without tools, or (over https) disconnected, after a timeout or network error
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions being shown as having stopped responding while Claude Code was still starting

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器調整倉庫複製路徑與資料夾規則
title.en: Self-hosted runner clone paths and folder rules

body.zh-TW:
管理 Self-hosted runner 的機器磁碟與掛載規則，有幾項資料夾路徑變動要留意。

同一個擁有者與倉庫名稱若來自第二個主機名稱，新的複製檔會放進基礎資料夾底下的 `_repos/clones/<host>/`，既有的複製檔不會搬動。

網址路徑含有特殊字元的倉庫，現在會改在新的資料夾重新複製。原本指定舊資料夾的規則與磁碟掛載區不再套用，舊資料夾本身則會留在原地。

啟動時若加上 `--capacity 1`，`--repository-folder` 可以接納基礎資料夾內大多數的資料夾。容量大於 1 時，若將 `--repository-folder` 指向基礎資料夾內的這類資料夾，會停止啟動。若有其他倉庫的工作階段重疊到該資料夾也會被拒絕。
body.en:
If you manage disk and mount rules for self-hosted runner machines, several folder path changes apply.

When a clone of the same owner and repository name comes from a second host name, it now goes under `_repos/clones/<host>/` in the base folder, and existing clones do not move.

Repositories with unusual characters in their URL path now clone anew into a new folder. Rules and disk volumes naming the old folder stop applying, while the old folder stays in place.

When starting with `--capacity 1`, `--repository-folder` accepts most folders inside the base folder. Above capacity 1, pointing `--repository-folder` to one of those folders in the base folder stops startup, and any session from another repository overlapping that folder is also refused.

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Changed a second host name's clone of the same owner/name to go under `_repos/clones/<host>/` in the base folder; no clone moves
Self-hosted runner: Changed repositories with unusual characters in their address path to clone anew in a new folder; rules and volumes naming the old one stop applying, and the old clone stays put
Self-hosted runner: Changed `--repository-folder` to take most folders in the base folder at `--capacity 1` (above 1, one there stops start-up); another repository's session overlapping one is refused

title.zh-TW: 代理團隊與背景任務的中斷、執行調整
title.en: Agent team and background task execution fixes

body.zh-TW:
同時指揮多個代理或跑背景任務，控制與中斷反應終於對得上指令了。

在代理團隊裡替具名隊友設定 Agent 工具的 `effort` 參數時，現在會真正生效，不再被忽略。

部分隊友窗格現在改透過 `/bin/sh` 啟動，因此可能不會讀取你原本設定的 shell 啟動檔。

背景代理正在恢復時被喊停，不會再繼續往下跑；雲端工作階段重啟期間若背景任務被停掉，Claude 現在也會收到通知。

在 Bedrock 上用 Claude Desktop 工作階段時，若卡在沒回應的 AWS `credential_process` 或登入呼叫，按下 Stop 現在能真正結束這次請求。
body.en:
Control and interruption responses now match your commands when directing multiple agents or running background tasks.

Setting the Agent tool's `effort` parameter for named teammates in agent teams now takes effect instead of being ignored.

Some teammate panes now start through `/bin/sh`, so they may not read your configured shell start-up files.

A background agent stopped while resuming no longer keeps running, and Claude is now notified when a background task is stopped while a cloud session is restarting.

In Claude Desktop sessions on Bedrock, pressing Stop now ends the request when waiting on an unresponsive AWS `credential_process` or sign-in call.

items.original:
Fixed a background agent running on when it was stopped while it was being resumed
Fixed Stop not ending a request in Claude Desktop sessions on Bedrock while it waits on a hung AWS credential_process or sign-in call
Fixed the Agent tool's `effort` parameter being ignored for named teammates in agent teams
Fixed Claude not being told when a background task was stopped while a cloud session was restarting
Changed some teammate panes to start through /bin/sh, so they may not read shell start-up files

title.zh-TW: 長時間對話、Desktop 與背景的記憶體瘦身
title.en: Memory reductions for long sessions, Desktop, and background

body.zh-TW:
跑久了編輯大量檔案或開著遠端連線，電腦記憶體比較不容易越吃越多。

背景執行的終端機指令，不會再在結束前一直抓著早期對話的記憶體不放。

在 Claude Desktop、各款 IDE 或 SDK 執行的工作階段裡，對話經過壓縮或執行 `/clear` 後，Remote Control 也不再繼續佔用早期對話的記憶體。

在編輯過大量檔案的長工作階段，以及 macOS 和 Linux 上累積許多大型 MCP 工具結果的 Claude Desktop 長工作階段中，記憶體用量都降低了。

閒置的 Claude Desktop 與 SDK 工作階段在長回合結束後，或是用 `--resume`、`--continue` 接回帶有截圖或大型工具結果的工作階段時，佔用的記憶體也更少。
body.en:
Memory is less likely to keep growing during long runs that edit many files or keep remote connections open.

Background shell commands no longer hold onto memory from the earlier conversation until they exit.

In sessions run by Claude Desktop, IDEs, or the SDK, Remote Control no longer holds onto memory from the earlier conversation after compaction or `/clear`.

Memory use is lower in long sessions that edit many files, as well as in long Claude Desktop sessions on macOS and Linux with many large MCP tool results.

Idle Claude Desktop and SDK sessions also use less memory after a long turn, or after using `--resume` or `--continue` on a session holding screenshots or large tool results.

items.original:
Fixed background shell commands using memory for the earlier conversation until they exit
Fixed Remote Control using memory for the earlier conversation after a compaction or `/clear` in sessions run by Claude Desktop, IDEs or the SDK
Improved memory use in long sessions that edit many files, and in long Claude Desktop sessions on macOS and Linux with many large MCP tool results
Improved memory use of idle Claude Desktop and SDK sessions after a long turn, and after `--resume` or `--continue` of a session that holds screenshots or large tool results

title.zh-TW: 外掛同步、無頭斷線與雲端重試修復
title.en: Plugin sync, headless disconnect, and cloud retry fixes

body.zh-TW:
外掛同步到各裝置使用時，外掛跟底下工具的開關總算對得上。

又修好一種在 macOS 工作階段執行期間，claude.ai 同步外掛的 hook 出現『Plugin directory does not exist』錯誤的情況。

在 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）工作階段裡，執行 `reload_plugins` 後，或帳號清單移除外掛後，已移除外掛連著的 MCP 伺服器會跟著斷開。

雲端工作階段啟動時，下載失敗的外掛現在會重試。
body.en:
When syncing plugins across devices, plugins and their underlying tools now stay in sync.

Fixed another case on macOS where a claude.ai-synced plugin hook failed with "Plugin directory does not exist" while a session was still running.

In headless (running without a terminal window) sessions, MCP servers attached to a removed plugin now disconnect after running `reload_plugins` or when the plugin is dropped from the account list.

Cloud sessions now retry plugins that fail to download at startup.

items.original:
Fixed another case of claude.ai-synced plugin hooks failing with "Plugin directory does not exist" while a session was still running on macOS
Fixed a removed plugin's MCP server staying connected in headless sessions after `reload_plugins` or when the account's plugin list drops it
Improved cloud sessions to retry plugins that failed to download at startup

title.zh-TW: 自動模式減少檢查加速並優化放行規則
title.en: Faster auto mode checks and improved allow rules

body.zh-TW:
開著自動模式讓 Claude 自己動手，現在少了幾道多餘的等待與誤擋。

自動模式減少了執行 `git status` 的頻率，大型專案裡多數請求的等待時間都變短。不過會直接捨棄修改內容的 git 指令仍可能先被擋下，直到工作目錄檢查過為止。

執行 `/auto-mode-setup` 掃描專案建議規則時，會參考近期的自動模式拒絕紀錄，也可能據此提出放行規則建議；每條都會先讓你確認，再儲存。

使用 `rm` 刪除指向工作目錄外或指向自己的 symlink（符號連結，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）時，不再跳出人工確認。

關閉遙測、透過閘道連 Anthropic API 或使用 Microsoft Foundry 時，對「yes」這類簡短回覆的處理更準確。

雲端工作階段請求失敗後，也不再指示 Claude 去執行會被自動模式擋下的網路代理檢查。
body.en:
Letting Claude work in auto mode now involves fewer unnecessary waits and false blocks.

Auto mode runs `git status` less often, shortening wait times for most requests in large repositories. However, a git command that discards changes may still be blocked until the working tree is checked.

When running `/auto-mode-setup` to scan a project for rules to suggest, it now considers recent auto mode denials and may propose allow rules from them, letting you review each one before saving.

Using `rm` to delete a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location) that points outside the working directory or at itself no longer asks for manual approval.

Handling of short replies such as "yes" is more accurate when telemetry is off, behind a gateway to the Anthropic API, or on Microsoft Foundry.

After a failed request in cloud sessions, Claude is no longer told to run a network proxy check that auto mode would block.

items.original:
Fixed auto mode asking for manual approval to `rm` a symlink that points outside the working directory or at itself
Fixed `/auto-mode-setup` ignoring recent auto mode denials when it scans a project for rules to suggest; it may now offer allow rules from them, and you review each before it's saved
Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude to run a network proxy check after a failed request, which auto mode then blocked
Improved auto mode's handling of a short reply such as "yes" to Claude's question when telemetry is off, behind a gateway to the Anthropic API, or on Microsoft Foundry
Changed auto mode to run `git status` less often so most requests wait less in large repositories; a git command that discards changes may be blocked until the working tree is checked

title.zh-TW: 修正 Linux /sandbox 通訊插槽誤標
title.en: Fixed Linux /sandbox socket status display

body.zh-TW: 過去看到清單把 `allowUnixSockets` 列為已允許，會以為這項設定有生效。其實在 Linux 下執行 `/sandbox` 並不會真的開放這些通訊插槽，現在 `/sandbox` 已改為如實標明不開放。
body.en: Seeing `allowUnixSockets` listed as allowed made it look like the setting took effect. In practice, running `/sandbox` on Linux does not open those sockets, and `/sandbox` now states that accurately.

items.original: Fixed `/sandbox` on Linux listing `allowUnixSockets` entries as allowed: they don't open those sockets there, and `/sandbox` now says so

title.zh-TW: 修正 /install-github-app 與分享狀態誤報
title.en: Fixed /install-github-app and sharing status reporting

body.zh-TW:
用 `/install-github-app` 裝 GitHub 應用打錯驗證碼，連按兩下 Esc 想清掉重打卻直接中止登入，現在可以安心清空重輸。

在 Team 與 Enterprise 方案執行 `/team-onboarding` 時，若伺服器其實拒絕了上傳，畫面不再誤報成指南已經分享成功。
body.en:
When installing the GitHub app with `/install-github-app`, pressing Esc twice to clear a mistyped code no longer ends the sign-in, so you can clear and re-enter it.

When running `/team-onboarding` on Team and Enterprise plans, the screen no longer reports a guide as shared if the server actually refused the upload.

items.original:
Fixed pressing Esc twice to clear a mistyped code ending the sign-in in `/install-github-app`
Fixed `/team-onboarding` reporting a guide as shared on Team and Enterprise plans when the server refused the upload

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 狀態同步與切換速度改善
title.en: Remote Control status sync and response speed improvements

body.zh-TW:
用手機或網頁端遠端操控電腦上的工作階段，畫面資訊跟操作節奏都更對得上了。

Remote Control 工作階段重啟後，不會再退回最初的思考力度，卻還在 App 上假裝顯示你原本選的等級。不過一開始就在 Ultracode 啟動的工作階段目前還不適用。

在 `claude remote-control` 工作階段裡用 `/rename` 改名，或是透過 `UserPromptSubmit` hook 設定的標題，現在都會如實顯示在 claude.ai 與手機端。

當分支把某個檔案改名後又接著編輯它時，Remote Control 的差異清單不會再把同一個檔案列兩次。

開啟 Remote Control 的 Claude Desktop Code 工作階段，在回答完畢後準備好接收下一則訊息的速度也變快了。
body.en:
Screen info and responsiveness now stay better aligned when controlling desktop sessions from mobile or the web.

After a Remote Control session restarts, it no longer falls back to its initial effort level while the app still shows the level you picked. However, this does not yet apply to sessions that start in Ultracode.

Titles set with `/rename` or a `UserPromptSubmit` hook in `claude remote-control` sessions now appear on claude.ai and mobile.

When a branch renames a file and then edits it, the Remote Control diff no longer lists the same file twice.

Claude Desktop Code sessions with Remote Control enabled are now ready for the next message faster after an answer.

items.original:
Remote Control: Fixed sessions going back to their first effort level after a restart while the app still showed the level you picked (not yet for sessions that start in Ultracode)
Fixed `/rename` and `UserPromptSubmit` hook titles in `claude remote-control` sessions not showing on claude.ai and mobile
Fixed the Remote Control diff listing a file twice when the branch renamed it and it was then edited
Improved how fast a Claude Desktop Code session with Remote Control on is ready for the next message after an answer

title.zh-TW: 修正外加目錄漏掃與無頭模式搶先分岔
title.en: Fix Missed Extra-Directory Scans and Early Headless Forking

body.zh-TW:
用 `--add-dir` 指定目前的工作目錄，或從家目錄啟動 Claude Code，過去可能會漏讀新建的 skills、commands 或 agents 資料夾，現在都能掃到。

在 headless 無頭模式下，如果切換模型後馬上送出的訊息還在等模型切換完成，倒轉與分岔不會再搶先往下執行。
body.en:
When you use `--add-dir` to point to the current working directory, or start Claude Code from your home folder, newly created skills, commands, or agents folders could previously be missed; now they are all scanned.

In headless mode (running without a terminal window), if a message sent right after switching models is still waiting for the model switch to finish, rewind and fork will no longer jump ahead and run early.

items.original:
Fixed a new skills, commands or agents folder being missed when `--add-dir` names the working directory or Claude Code starts in the home folder
Fixed headless rewind and fork going ahead while a message sent right after a model change still waited on it

title.zh-TW: 專案設定套用與權限儲存警告修復
title.en: Project Settings Application and Permission Save Warning Fixes

body.zh-TW:
改完專案設定卻覺得沒生效，或存權限時莫名跳警告，這些狀況都修好了。

從預熱程序啟動的工作階段，現在會讀取專案 `.claude/settings.json` 裡的 `autoCompactWindow` 設定，不再略過。

從 `settings.json` 拿掉 `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` 後，正在跑的工作階段也會立刻解除它的效果，不再殘留。

在子資料夾或 worktree（工作樹，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）裡，有時自己的 `.claude/settings.local.json` 無法讀取或格式有誤。在此新增權限規則或資料夾時，現在不會再誤跳「Couldn't save this change」警告。
body.en:
If you changed project settings and felt they didn't take effect, or saw an unexpected warning when saving permissions, those issues are now fixed.

Sessions started from a pre-warmed process now read the `autoCompactWindow` setting in the project's `.claude/settings.json` instead of skipping it.

After removing `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` from `settings.json`, running sessions also immediately lift its effect instead of letting it linger.

In a subfolder or worktree (a Git feature that lets you open multiple parallel copies of the same project), its own `.claude/settings.local.json` can sometimes be unreadable or malformed. Adding a permission rule or folder there will no longer falsely trigger a "Couldn't save this change" warning.

items.original:
Fixed sessions started from a pre-warmed process ignoring the `autoCompactWindow` setting in the project's `.claude/settings.json`
Fixed `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` staying in effect in a running session after it is removed from settings.json
Fixed a false "Couldn't save this change" warning after adding a permission rule or directory in a subfolder or worktree whose own `.claude/settings.local.json` is unreadable or malformed

title.zh-TW: 終端機畫面捲動、提示列與視窗裁切修復
title.en: Terminal Scrolling, Prompt Bar, and Window Clipping Fixes

body.zh-TW:
在終端機翻看歷史紀錄、開全螢幕或縮小視窗，畫面不再動不動缺字斷行。

全螢幕下的面板與提問不再在輸入列被截斷。視窗較矮時，`/help`、歷史搜尋與背景任務清單不會再漏列或遺失標題，對話框裡的表格也不會亂折行。

複製文字後往上捲，「Jump to bottom」按鈕不再繼續躲起來，標籤換字時底下那行也不會變空白。全螢幕下連按 PageUp 也不會捲過頭。

記憶體吃緊時畫面不再偶爾漏掉更新，長程式碼區塊在捲動紀錄裡也不會少一行空白卻重複另一行。

輸入列文字若帶著同時設定多種樣式的色碼，又有關鍵字或指令被突顯，字元不再無故消失。
body.en:
When browsing history in the terminal, going fullscreen, or shrinking the window, the display no longer drops characters or breaks lines unexpectedly.

Panels and questions in fullscreen are no longer cut off at the prompt bar. In shorter windows, `/help`, history search, and the background tasks list no longer drop rows or lose titles, and tables in dialogs no longer wrap awkwardly.

After copying text and scrolling up, the "Jump to bottom" button no longer stays hidden, and the row beneath it no longer goes blank when its label changes. Pressing PageUp repeatedly in fullscreen also no longer scrolls too far.

When memory is tight, screen updates are no longer occasionally skipped, and long code blocks in scrollback no longer drop a blank line while repeating another.

When prompt text contains a color code that sets multiple styles at once and a keyword or command is highlighted, characters no longer disappear for no reason.

items.original:
Fixed panels and questions being cut off at the prompt in fullscreen, `/help`, history search and the background tasks list losing rows or titles in short windows, and tables wrapping in dialogs
Fixed the "Jump to bottom" pill staying hidden after copying text and scrolling away, the row under it going blank when its label changed, and quick PageUp presses scrolling too far in fullscreen
Fixed a screen update sometimes being skipped when memory is low
Fixed long code blocks losing a blank line and repeating another in scrollback
Fixed characters disappearing from the prompt when its text held a color code that sets several styles and a keyword or command was highlighted

title.zh-TW: 對話接續標記、讀檔行數與說明輸出修復
title.en: Session Resume Labels, File Line Counts, and Help Output Fixes

body.zh-TW:
接續舊對話或查看檔案與指令說明，畫面上幾處誤導人的文字都拿掉了。

接回上次工作階段時，原本因對話結束而被中斷的編輯、提問與計畫，不會再被誤標為「Rejected」或「Declined」。接續時提及早期訊息的那行提示，也不再冤枉完好無缺的檔案已損毀。

讀取工具與 `@` 提及功能在遇到結尾有換行符的檔案時，不再多顯示一行。

輸入框的下一句建議不再偶爾冒出 `_(no suggestion)_` 這類佔位文字。

將 `claude --help` 的說明文字透過管線傳給其他程式時，輸出內容不會再半路被截斷。
body.en:
Several misleading bits of text on screen when resuming an old conversation or viewing files and command help have been removed.

When resuming a previous session, edits, questions, and plans that were cut off because the conversation ended are no longer mislabeled as "Rejected" or "Declined". The hint line mentioning earlier messages on resume also no longer falsely blames an intact file for being damaged.

The Read tool and `@` mentions no longer display one extra line for files that end with a newline.

Prompt suggestions in the input box no longer occasionally show placeholder text like `_(no suggestion)_`.

Piping `claude --help` output to another program no longer cuts off the text partway through.

items.original:
Fixed resumed sessions showing "Rejected" or "Declined" for edits, questions and plans that were cut off when the session ended
Fixed `claude --help` output being cut short when piped to another program
Fixed Read and @-mentions showing one line too many for files that end in a newline
Fixed prompt suggestions sometimes showing placeholder text such as `_(no suggestion)_`
Fixed the line about earlier messages on resume blaming a damaged file when the file was intact

title.zh-TW: 設定畫面防卡死、重啟等登入與舊對話清理
title.en: Setup Screen Freeze Fix, Restart Login Wait, and Old Session Cleanup

body.zh-TW:
進出工作階段與重啟介面，現在少了不少卡住或無故被登出的煩惱。

當 `--resume` 選單、信任確認對話框或其他設定畫面正等著你操作時，核准受管理設定後不再卡在一片空白畫面動彈不得。

執行 `/tui` 或其他就地重啟動作時，現在會短暫等待登入狀態重新整理完畢，比較不會因此把你登出。

在套用受管理設定的電腦上，自動清理舊工作階段的動作也改善了。
body.en:
Entering or leaving sessions and restarting the interface now comes with far fewer freezes or unexpected sign-outs.

When the `--resume` picker, trust confirmation dialog, or another setup screen is waiting for your input, approving managed settings no longer leaves you stuck on an empty, frozen screen.

Running `/tui` or other in-place restarts now waits briefly for the login state to finish refreshing, making it less likely to sign you out.

On computers with managed settings applied, automatic cleanup of old sessions has also been improved.

items.original:
Fixed an empty, frozen screen after approving managed settings while the --resume picker, the trust dialog or another set-up screen was waiting
Improved the automatic clean-up of old sessions on computers with managed settings
Improved `/tui` and other in-place restarts to wait briefly for a login refresh, so they are less likely to sign you out

title.zh-TW: Windows 搜尋程式啟動慢的電腦等待縮短
title.en: Shorter Wait on Windows PCs With Slow Search Startup

body.zh-TW: 你在 Windows 上打開 Claude Code 準備開工，或是要做第一筆查詢，如果裡頭的檢索工具起步比較費時，過去常會卡住一陣子。現在啟動與首次搜尋的等待時間縮短了。
body.en: When you open Claude Code on Windows to get started or run your first query, if its built-in search tool takes a while to start up, it used to stall for a bit. Now the wait time for startup and the first search is shorter.

items.original: Windows: Improved start-up and the first search on PCs where Claude Code's search program starts slowly

title.zh-TW: macOS 電腦操控套用新安全規則與逾時上限
title.en: New Safety Rules and Launch Timeout for macOS Computer Use

body.zh-TW:
讓 Claude 直接幫你操作 macOS 畫面，安全界線與等待時間都有新規定。電腦操控功能已更新到較新的安全規範，部分動作會被拒絕執行，某些應用程式能取用的範圍也縮減了。

要由它開啟某個應用程式時，若超過 30 秒還沒啟動完成，它就會直接放棄，不會一直乾等下去。

⟦好比請鄰居小孩幫忙進屋按家電開關，現在多了幾道鎖住不准碰的抽屜，超過 30 秒還轉不開的舊水龍頭也會直接放手，不再傻等。⟧
body.en:
When letting Claude operate your macOS screen directly, there are new rules for both safety boundaries and wait times. Computer use has been updated to newer safety guidelines, so some actions will be refused and certain apps have reduced access.

When asking it to open an app, if the launch hasn't finished after 30 seconds, it gives up right away instead of waiting indefinitely.

⟦Asking a neighbor's kid to come inside and flip appliance switches works much the same way: now several drawers are locked off-limits, and if an old faucet won't budge after 30 seconds, they just let go instead of waiting around.⟧

items.original:
Updated computer use on macOS to newer safety rules, so some actions are refused and some apps have less access
Changed computer use on macOS to give up on an app launch that has not finished after 30 seconds

title.zh-TW: Gateway 空白名單啟動改為每次框出警語
title.en: Boxed Startup Warning on Every Launch When Gateway Allowlist Is Empty

body.zh-TW:
架設 Gateway（閘道器，轉發流量的入口服務）時，如果 `access_control.allow_cidrs` 允許清單留空，原本的啟動警告改成每次啟動都會出現。這則提醒在純文字紀錄裡會用方框框起來：絕對不要把 Gateway 直接暴露在公開網際網路上。

⟦跟店面每天開門一樣，只要還沒設定誰能進來，一拉開鐵門就會在日誌裡印出框起來的提醒「別把大門對著大街敞開」。⟧
body.en:
When running Gateway (an entry service that forwards traffic), if the `access_control.allow_cidrs` allowlist is left empty, the previous startup warning now appears on every launch. This notice is boxed in plain-text logs: never expose Gateway directly to the public internet.

⟦Much like a shop opening its doors each morning, as long as nobody has set who is allowed inside, rolling up the shutter prints a boxed reminder in the log: "Don't leave the front door wide open to the street."⟧

items.original: Gateway: Changed the start-up warning shown while `access_control.allow_cidrs` is empty to a notice at every start, boxed in text logs: never expose the gateway to the public internet

title.zh-TW: 移除 max_tokens 錯誤的自動重試機制
title.en: Remove Automatic Retry on max_tokens Errors

body.zh-TW:
你送出的請求若撞上 `max_tokens` 限制，2.1.326 原本會依報錯訊息列出的上限再送一次。這一版已取消這個作法。

如果你的閘道後方模型能接受的輸出 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）較少，請自行將環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` 設為該上限值。

⟦就像貨車超重被攔下時，以前車隊會照告示牌上的限重自動減量再發車，現在不再自動重試，得在出發前自己把上限填好。⟧
body.en:
If your request hit the `max_tokens` limit, 2.1.326 previously retried using the cap listed in the error message. This release removes that behavior.

If the model behind your gateway accepts fewer output tokens (the text units AI processes and bills by), set the `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` environment variable to that limit yourself.

⟦When a truck gets pulled over for being overweight, the fleet used to automatically lighten the load to match the posted limit and send it back out, whereas now it won't retry on its own and you have to enter the limit before heading out.⟧

items.original: Removed 2.1.326's automatic retry at the limit named in a `max_tokens` error; behind a gateway whose model takes fewer output tokens, set `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` to that limit

title.zh-TW: VS Code 信任重審提示與登入、額度顯示
title.en: VS Code Review Trust Prompt, Sign-In Refresh, and Credits Banner

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 拒絕信任資料夾、等登入回應或看額度橫幅，操作與顯示都更順手。

拒絕信任提示後，訊息框上方會多出一行提示與「Review trust」按鈕，不用重載整個視窗就能再把信任提示叫回來。

登入伺服器花了 10 到 30 秒才回應擴充功能的 token 更新時，不會再連累所有視窗和終端機裡的 Claude Code 一起被登出。

正在使用點數時，額度上限橫幅現在會如實標示，工作階段問卷也不會再擋住這條橫幅跟使用點數卡片。

⟦跟逛網站先按了「暫不同意條款」一樣，現在輸入欄上方會留一條小按鈕讓你隨時補按，不用整頁重刷，問卷小卡也不再蓋住剩餘點數。⟧
body.en:
Declining folder trust, waiting on sign-in responses, and viewing the quota banner in VS Code are all smoother now.

After you decline the trust prompt, an extra line with a "Review trust" button appears above the message box so you can bring the trust prompt back without reloading the whole window.

When the sign-in server takes 10 to 30 seconds to answer the extension's token refresh, it no longer signs you out of Claude Code across all windows and terminals.

When usage credits are in use, the limit banner now says so accurately, and the session survey no longer covers that banner or the usage credits card.

⟦Suppose you clicked "Decline terms for now" on a website: now a small button stays above the input bar so you can accept anytime without reloading the whole page, and the survey card no longer covers your remaining credits.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a line above the message box after you decline the trust prompt, with Review trust to bring the prompt back without reloading the window
[VSCode] Fixed being signed out of Claude Code in every window and terminal when the sign-in server took 10 to 30 seconds to answer the extension's token refresh
[VSCode] Fixed the limit banner not saying when usage credits are in use, and the session survey covering that banner and the usage credits card

title.zh-TW: VS Code 權限提示原因與鍵盤焦點調整
title.en: VS Code Permission Prompt Reasons and Keyboard Focus

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 確認內建工具的權限時，現在看得到安全檢查為什麼要問；其他權限提示用鍵盤或螢幕報讀也更好操作。

遇到 Bash、Edit、Write 等內建工具要求確認時，畫面會直接寫明安全檢查詢問的原因，不用靠猜。

開著「Account & Usage」對話框期間若有新的權限請求進來，螢幕報讀器現在會立刻播報，不用等到你關掉對話框才聽到。

當權限視窗的按鈕亮起啟用時，鍵盤焦點不會再被搶走，你可以安心繼續往下捲動看細節。

在權限清單一路按方向鍵 Down 時，現在會停在最後一個選項，不會再循環跳回「Yes」。
body.en:
When confirming permissions for built-in tools in VS Code, you can now see why a safety check is asking; other permission prompts are also easier to use with a keyboard or screen reader.

When built-in tools such as Bash, Edit, and Write ask for confirmation, the prompt now states why the safety check is asking instead of leaving you to guess.

If a new permission request arrives while the "Account & Usage" dialog is open, screen readers now announce it right away instead of waiting until you close the dialog.

When buttons in a permission prompt switch on, keyboard focus is no longer pulled away so you can keep scrolling down through the details.

Pressing the Down arrow key through a permission prompt now stops at the last item instead of wrapping back to "Yes".

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt for Bash, Edit, Write and other built-in tools not showing why a safety check asks
[VSCode] Fixed screen readers not announcing a permission request that arrived while the Account & Usage dialog was open until that dialog was closed
[VSCode] Fixed a permission prompt moving keyboard focus away from the details you were scrolling as its buttons switched on
[VSCode] Changed Down to stop at the last item of a permission prompt instead of wrapping to Yes

title.zh-TW: VS Code 中文輸入法組字防誤觸修復
title.en: VS Code Chinese Input Method Composition Fixes

body.zh-TW:
用中文輸入法選字卻不小心按到 Enter 送出，是不是很崩潰？在 VS Code 用中文或日文等輸入法打字時，現在不會再因為一個按鍵就誤觸選單或蓋掉輸入內容。

輸入法正在組字期間按下按鍵，不會再誤移權限提示的焦點、直接拒絕確認、觸發選單列項目或把對話框關掉。

寫到一半的計畫評論不會再無故遺失或跑去別段文字。組字選字時按 Enter，也不再誤把評論送出、提早結束工作階段改名，或是錯選 `@` 提及的檔案。

在訊息框組字時按方向鍵 Up，也不再直接叫出上一則歷史訊息把剛打好的組字蓋掉。
body.en:
Ever hit Enter by mistake while picking a character in a Chinese input method? When typing with an input method such as Chinese or Japanese in VS Code, a single keystroke no longer triggers menus or overwrites your input by accident.

Keys pressed while an input method is composing no longer move focus on a permission prompt, decline confirmation, trigger menu bar items, or close dialogs.

A half-written plan comment is no longer lost or moved to another passage. Pressing Enter while composing also no longer sends the comment, ends a session rename early, or picks an `@`-mentioned file by mistake.

Pressing the Up arrow key while composing in the message box no longer pulls up an earlier message over the text you are composing.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed keys pressed while an input method (IME) is composing moving focus on or declining a permission prompt, running menu rows and closing dialogs (anthropics/claude-code#106358)
[VSCode] Fixed a half-written plan comment being lost or moved to another passage, and an input method's Enter sending the comment, ending a session rename or picking an @-mentioned file
[VSCode] Fixed the Up key putting an earlier message over text that an input method (IME) is composing in the message box (anthropics/claude-code#101294)

title.zh-TW: VS Code 分頁開啟、差異頁與拖曳修復
title.en: VS Code Tab Opening, Diff, and Drag-and-Drop Fixes

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 拖放資料夾、點連結開檔或看工具輸出，分頁跟按鈕不再跟你作對。

當終端機的 Claude Code 工作階段斷線後，原本的建議修改差異分頁不再繼續留著，裡面那個按了沒反應的 Accept 按鈕也會一起收掉。

工具的簡短輸入與輸出被面板邊緣裁切時，現在可以點開到編輯器分頁看完整內容。單純拖曳反白選取文字時，也不會再誤開新分頁。

在 VS Code 1.103 到 1.139 版或浮動聊天視窗裡，從檔案總管把資料夾拖進對話框不再毫無反應，拖曳亮框也不會消失並錯跳「Hold Shift」提示。

關閉 `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` 設定時，在 Claude 分頁點檔案連結也不再跑去別的編輯器群組打開。
body.en:
Dragging folders, clicking links to open files, and viewing tool output in VS Code no longer fight you with broken tabs and buttons.

After a terminal Claude Code session disconnects, its proposed-edit diff tab no longer stays open along with the Accept button that did nothing.

When short tool inputs and outputs are cut off at the panel's edge, you can now click to open the full content in an editor tab. Dragging to select text also no longer opens a new tab by mistake.

On VS Code 1.103 to 1.139 or in a floating chat window, dropping an Explorer folder onto the chat no longer does nothing, and the drop highlight no longer vanishes with a false "Hold Shift" hint.

When `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` is off, clicking file links in a Claude tab no longer opens them in another editor group.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a proposed-edit diff tab staying open, with an Accept button that did nothing, after its terminal Claude Code session disconnected
[VSCode] Fixed short tool inputs and outputs cut off at the panel's edge with no way to read the rest (they now open in an editor tab), and dragging to select text also opening one
[VSCode] Fixed dropping an Explorer folder onto the chat inserting nothing on VS Code 1.103 to 1.139 or in a floating chat window, and the drop highlight vanishing with a false "Hold Shift" hint
[VSCode] Fixed file links in a Claude tab opening in another editor group when `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` is off (anthropics/claude-code#108884)

title.zh-TW: VS Code 刪除線、聽寫與指令文字顯示調整
title.en: VS Code Strikethrough, Dictation, and Command Text Display

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 查看對話文字或指令輸出，格式跟字元的呈現方式有些變動。

像 `3~5 … 7~10` 這類用單個波浪號寫出來的數值範圍，不會再被吃掉波浪號並把中間文字畫上刪除線，現在只有雙波浪號 `~~text~~` 會顯示刪除線。

語音聽寫的錯誤訊息不再擠成細長的一欄，提問卡等待回答時轉圈圖示也不會一直轉個不停，執行失敗的 UTF-16 指令輸出也不再每個字母後面都冒出 NUL 符號。

指令輸出現在會把純顏色以外的隱藏字元與控制序列顯示成可見符號。這也讓波斯語、高棉語、寮語、僧伽羅語和馬拉雅拉姆語的文字目前看起來可能破碎或順序錯亂。

⟦如同校對文章時把原本該印出來的波浪符號還原，並把隱藏的排版控制碼改用顯眼記號標出，代價是少數特定語言的文字排版暫時會被拆開。⟧
body.en:
Viewing chat text or command output in VS Code comes with a few changes to how formatting and characters are displayed.

Numeric ranges written with a single tilde, such as `3~5 … 7~10`, no longer lose their tildes and show struck-through text in between; only double tildes `~~text~~` render as strikethrough now.

Dictation error messages no longer wrap into a narrow column, the spinner no longer keeps turning while a question card waits for an answer, and output from a failed UTF-16 command no longer shows a NUL symbol after each letter.

Command output now renders hidden characters and control sequences other than plain colors as visible symbols. As a result, Persian, Khmer, Lao, Sinhala, and Malayalam text can currently look broken or out of order.

⟦Proofreading a manuscript this way restores the tildes meant to be printed and flags hidden formatting codes with visible symbols, though the layout of a few specific languages breaks for now.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed ranges written with a single tilde (`3~5 … 7~10`) losing their tildes and showing struck-through text between them; only `~~text~~` is struck through now
[VSCode] Fixed dictation errors wrapping into a narrow column, the spinner turning while a question card waits, and a NUL symbol after each letter in the output of a failed UTF-16 command
[VSCode] Changed command output to show hidden characters and control sequences other than plain colors as symbols, so Persian, Khmer, Lao, Sinhala and Malayalam text can look broken or out of order

title.en: Model Catalogs Add GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra

body.zh-TW: 開新對話前打開選單，裡頭現在多了兩位新成員。模型目錄已加入 GPT-6.2 Sol 與 Astra，並直接將 Sol 設為目錄的預設選項。⟦好比文具店把兩款新筆放上陳列架，以前架上只有舊款式，現在不只多了新選擇，其中一款還直接擺在最順手的預設位置。⟧

title.zh-TW: TUI 工作區預設開啟並排顯示預覽
title.en: TUI Workspace Enabled by Default with Side-by-Side Previews

body.zh-TW:
一邊請 AI 改資料、一邊還得另外開視窗翻文件，視線常在好幾個地方跳來跳去。現在 TUI（終端機裡的文字操作介面）的工作區會預設開啟，不用另外切換就能直接看到並排畫面。

主對話旁邊會直接列出可搜尋的文件預覽與圖片預覽。如果有子代理（幫主對話分頭處理工作的助手）在執行，它的完整對話紀錄也會一併擺在旁邊方便對照。⟦就像整理報告時把資料夾攤在書桌兩側，以前要逐份翻找核對，現在主稿旁直接擺好參考文件、圖片和分頭調查的筆記。⟧
body.en:
Having to open a separate window to flip through documents while asking AI to edit data often leaves your eyes jumping between several places. Now the TUI (a text-based interface in the terminal) workspace is enabled by default, so you can see a side-by-side layout without switching views.

Searchable document previews and image previews appear right next to the main conversation. If a subagent (an assistant that handles parallel work for the main conversation) is running, its full transcript is placed alongside it for easy comparison. ⟦Think of spreading folders across both sides of your desk while organizing a report: instead of flipping through files one by one, your reference docs, images, and side-investigation notes sit right next to your main draft.⟧

items.original: Enabled the TUI workspace by default, with searchable document previews, image previews, and subagent transcripts alongside the main conversation. (#61352, #61888, #61889, #61919, #62157)

title.zh-TW: 非 Vim 輸入區新增可自訂復原與重做鍵
title.en: Non-Vim Composer Adds Configurable Undo and Redo Shortcuts

body.zh-TW:
整理報告貼了一大段參考資料又附了檔案，卻手滑把整塊指令全刪掉。現在只要不是在 Vim（一種純鍵盤操作的編輯模式）下，提示詞輸入區都能設定復原與重做快捷鍵。

操作時不只純文字會恢復，先前夾帶的附件和大段貼上的內容也會完整回到輸入框裡。⟦跟在剪貼簿做拼貼一樣，不小心把剪好的圖文整塊掃掉，拉回一步就能把整張照片和長剪報原封不動放回桌面。⟧
body.en:
You paste a large block of reference material and attach a file while organizing a report, only to slip and delete the entire prompt. Now, as long as you are not in Vim (a keyboard-only editing mode), you can configure undo and redo shortcuts in the prompt composer.

When you trigger them, not only is plain text restored, but previously attached files and large pasted blocks also return intact to the input box. ⟦Just like making a collage on a clipboard, if you accidentally sweep away a whole chunk of cut-out text and images, stepping back puts the entire photo and long clipping right back on the table.⟧

items.original: Added configurable undo and redo shortcuts to the non-Vim prompt composer, including restoration of attachments and large pastes. (#61954)

title.zh-TW: codex exec 新增 --remote 參數
title.en: codex exec Adds --remote Flag

body.zh-TW:
遠端機器上已經跑著一個 Codex 服務，想在腳本裡直接交辦任務。只要執行下面這行指令，就能連上既有的應用程式伺服器，啟動或接續非互動式工作階段（送出指令後直接跑完、不需來回對話）：

```bash
codex exec --remote <ADDR> # 將 <ADDR> 換成目標伺服器位址
```

⟦如同工廠裡早就開機運轉的產線，直接把物料送上既有產線就能開工或續跑。⟧
body.en:
A Codex service is already running on a remote machine, and you want to dispatch tasks to it from a script. By running the command below, you can connect to an existing app server and start or resume noninteractive sessions (runs that finish after you send a command, without back-and-forth):

```bash
codex exec --remote <ADDR> # Replace <ADDR> with the target server address
```

⟦A factory production line is already up and running—you simply feed materials onto the existing line to start or continue work.⟧

items.original: Added `codex exec --remote <ADDR>` to start or resume noninteractive sessions on an existing app server. (#61707)

title.zh-TW: 終端機新增 /rc 與 /remote 管理遠端控制
title.en: Terminal Adds /rc and /remote to Manage Remote Control

body.en: When you step away from your desk and want to use another device to remotely control a conversation running locally, how do you pair quickly? In the terminal interface, enter `/rc` or `/remote` to manage local remote control and display device pairing codes directly. ⟦It is like connecting a smart TV in the living room by bringing up the pairing code right on the screen.⟧

title.zh-TW: /statusline 可自訂與選用 MCP 狀態列
title.en: /statusline Supports Custom and Selectable MCP Status Lines

body.zh-TW:
盯著終端機底部看久了，難免想把常用的外部工具資訊也釘在那一排。只要啟用 `tui_extensions_statusline`，就能用 `/statusline` 管理底部的資訊欄。

透過這個指令，你可以自由挑選現成樣式，或自己編寫要顯示的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）狀態列。⟦拿汽車儀表板來比方，以前出廠給哪幾顆燈號就只能看哪幾顆，現在能自己挑選或組裝想看的小工具欄位擺上去。⟧
body.en:
After staring at the bottom of the terminal for a while, it is natural to want information from your frequently used external tools pinned right there. Once `tui_extensions_statusline` is enabled, you can use `/statusline` to manage the bottom status bar.

Through this command, you can pick from ready-made styles or author your own MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) status line to display. ⟦Compare it to a car dashboard: before, you could only watch the factory indicator lights, whereas now you can pick or assemble the widget fields you want to display.⟧

items.original: Added custom MCP status line selection and authoring through `/statusline` when `tui_extensions_statusline` is enabled. (#61979, #61988, #62037)

title.zh-TW: 切換或插話調整時不再覆蓋既有進度與權限
title.en: Switching or Steering No Longer Overwrites Progress and Permissions

body.zh-TW:
在多個任務之間切換、或在對話途中調整方向，原本的設定與寫到一半的內容現在都能穩穩留住。

切換或接續工作階段時，打到一半的草稿、排隊等送出的後續訊息，以及被打斷的輸入都會跟著原本的對話串留存。

把工作目錄換到別的資料夾時，原本設定好的權限設定檔會原封不動保留下來。

上一輪如果延遲送出完成通知，不會再誤把新一輪正在等待確認的權限核准直接取消。

在進行中的這一輪中途插話調整方向時，彙總的變更差異裡依然會保留更早之前的修改。

以前切個對話或改個目錄就得擔心草稿、權限與修改紀錄不見，現在這些進行中的狀態都能完整延續。
body.en:
Switching between tasks or adjusting direction mid-conversation now keeps your existing settings and half-written work intact.

When switching or resuming sessions, in-progress drafts, queued follow-up messages, and interrupted input stay with their original threads.

When changing your working directory to another folder, previously configured permission profiles remain untouched.

A late completion notification from a previous turn will no longer mistakenly cancel a pending permission approval for a newer turn.

When steering an active turn mid-way, aggregate diffs still preserve earlier edits.

Previously, switching conversations or changing directories meant worrying about losing drafts, permissions, and edit history; now these active states carry over intact.

items.original:
Preserved drafts, queued follow-ups, and interrupted input with their original threads when switching or resuming sessions. (#61216)
Kept permission profiles intact when changing working directories. (#61195)
Prevented late completion events from cancelling approvals for a newer turn. (#61801)
Preserved earlier edits in aggregate diffs when steering an active turn. (#61820)

title.zh-TW: 修正只發 ID token 的企業版 MCP 登入問題
title.en: Fixed Enterprise MCP Sign-In When Only ID Tokens Are Issued

body.zh-TW: 透過公司帳號驗證身分，有些服務只會核發 ID token（用來確認身分的授權令牌）。由於沒有附上用來續期的 refresh token，以前這種設定會讓企業版 MCP 登入失敗。這個問題已經修好，現在只拿到 ID token 也能正常登入企業版 MCP。
body.en: When verifying identity through a company account, some services only issue an ID token (an authorization credential used to verify identity). Because no refresh token was included for renewal, this setup previously caused enterprise MCP sign-in to fail. That issue is now fixed, so enterprise MCP sign-in works normally even when only an ID token is received.

items.original: Fixed enterprise MCP sign-in for identity providers that issue ID tokens without refresh tokens. (#62129)

title.zh-TW: 給自行編譯者：建置工具與 XML 套件更新
