entries: Added an auto-compaction threshold row under the capacity header in `/context`, and updated `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` to support all eligible models: pass a token count (`700000`), a `K` or `M` shorthand (`800K`, `0.5M`), or a percentage (`80%`) up to the model's context window to set when conversations compact, and see the active override in `/context` and `/model`.
Improved text contrast in the `tokyo night` color scheme so expanded thoughts, tool output, and dimmed hints stand apart from agent responses while staying easy to read.

Improved the project picker on the home screen and new-conversation panes of the Remote Control browser view: it now shows a flat, scrollable list of projects sorted by recency instead of a three-item `Recent` group and nested submenus, and when remote environments are available, places the `This Computer` / `Remote` picker ahead of the project picker to filter projects by environment, remember your last-used project in each one, and open local GitHub projects remotely from `Clone from This Computer`.

Improved the queued-messages card in the Remote Control browser view when the agent's main turn has finished but background work is still holding the queue: instead of `Sends after agent finishes working`, the header now shows `Waiting on ...` with the active subagent count and up to two non-daemon background task or timer titles, while daemon tasks such as dev servers don't hold the queue and `Send Now` still sends right away.

Improved permission prompts in the Remote Control browser view by bolding the target folder path, command pattern, or domain in "always allow" option labels — updating live when you edit the target — so the scope a rule grants stands out at a glance.

Changed the default thinking `Effort` for the `Orchestrator` row's `Planner` and `Executor` roles in `/model` to `high` when available (falling back to the model family's highest offered level otherwise); previously unset roles and newly selected model families defaulted to the family's highest level, such as `xhigh` or `max`. Your saved `"orchestrator"` choices in `settings.json` are unchanged.

Changed local conversation storage to keep all saved conversations in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations` by default; previously the CLI pruned older saved conversations beyond the `500` most recent at startup.
Fixed `/btw` side questions in conversations using `Orchestrator` dropping plan-and-execute instead of inheriting your configured `Planner` and `Executor` models and thinking `Effort`.
Fixed `/config` showing a false `⚠ terminal does not support alt screen` warning under `Rendering Mode` in Windows PowerShell and Command Prompt consoles when `TERM` is unset.

Fixed `/config` running `Rendering Mode` warnings (such as `⚠ alt screen unavailable — run ssh -t`) into the setting description in dim text, saying `terminal "unknown"` when the terminal name is unavailable, and cutting off multi-line setting descriptions past three lines.

Fixed `agy acp` replying to `session/load` before finishing history replay (or cutting off replay after 2 seconds on long conversations), dropping active permission or question prompts when attaching to a running session, and returning JSON-RPC error `-32603` instead of `-32002` when a session ID does not exist.

Fixed `agy acp` skipping leading slash commands or skills (such as `/plan` or `/compact`) when the editor attached files, selections, images, or links ahead of the prompt text, dropping empty (`0`-byte) attached files, and treating web URLs or line-range resource links as local file paths.

Fixed `agy acp` ending a `session/prompt` turn as soon as the agent's initial reply finished while non-daemon background tasks or subagents were still running; the turn now stays open across background wake-ups until that work finishes and reports the combined token usage, while daemon tasks such as dev servers still let the turn end right away.

Fixed `agy acp` leaving in-progress tool calls stuck open in the editor when a turn is interrupted or canceled with `session/cancel`, and omitting error messages on failed tool calls that produced no command or diff output.

Fixed splitting a terminal tab in the side panel of the Remote Control browser view reloading the terminal and losing its scroll position and focus, kept the oldest pane as the group's lead pane and tab title when new split panes are added, and moved off an exited terminal tab when another terminal opened at the same time.

Fixed the keyboard- and screen-reader-focusable `Load older messages` pill at the top of long conversations in the Remote Control browser view clipping against the mobile title bar, scrolling back to the bottom of the chat when focused or clicked, and letting `Esc` close an enclosing mobile drawer instead of dismissing the pill.

title.zh-TW: /context 顯示自動壓縮門檻
title.en: /context shows auto-compaction threshold

body.zh-TW:
對話越聊越長、快接近模型上限，你可能想知道究竟何時會觸發整理。`/context` 的容量標題底下新增了一列自動壓縮門檻。

環境變數（程式啟動時讀取的設定）`AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` 也改為支援所有符合條件的模型。想自己抓時機壓縮對話，只要設好這個變數，就能指定在多少 `token`（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）時啟動，上限為該模型的脈絡視窗大小。

數值可用 `700000` 這類具體數量、`800K` 或 `0.5M` 這類縮寫，或 `80%` 這類百分比。設好後，在 `/context` 和 `/model` 都能看見目前生效的設定。⟦就像替倉庫設好八分滿警報，以前快堆滿才慌張騰空間，現在你能自訂幾成滿就提前整理，看板上也看得到目前門檻。⟧
body.en:
As a conversation grows longer and nears the model limit, you might wonder when cleanup will trigger. `/context` now adds an auto-compaction threshold row under the capacity header.

The `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` environment variable (a setting read when a program starts) now also supports all eligible models. To time conversation compaction yourself, set this variable to specify how many `token` (the text units AI processes and bills by) trigger it, up to the model's context window size.

You can pass an exact count like `700000`, a shorthand like `800K` or `0.5M`, or a percentage like `80%`. Once set, you can see the active override in both `/context` and `/model`. ⟦Picture setting an eighty-percent-full alarm for a warehouse: instead of scrambling to clear space only when it is nearly packed, you can choose how full it gets before tidying up early, and the dashboard shows your current threshold.⟧

items.original: Added an auto-compaction threshold row under the capacity header in `/context`, and updated `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` to support all eligible models: pass a token count (`700000`), a `K` or `M` shorthand (`800K`, `0.5M`), or a percentage (`80%`) up to the model's context window to set when conversations compact, and see the active override in `/context` and `/model`.

title.zh-TW: Orchestrator 思考力度與 /btw 修好
title.en: Orchestrator thinking effort and /btw fixed

body.zh-TW:
開啟 `Orchestrator` 讓規劃與執行分開跑時，未設定的角色與新選取的模型家族，以前預設採用該家族最高思考等級。現在 `/model` 中 `Orchestrator` 列的 `Planner` 與 `Executor`，預設 `Effort` 改成 `high`。沒有 `high` 則仍採用該家族最高等級。

存在 `settings.json` 的 `"orchestrator"` 選項不會改變。

在其中用 `/btw` 問旁支問題時，過去會失去規劃再執行的分工，現在會沿用設好的 `Planner`、`Executor` 模型與 `Effort`。⟦請建築師和工班施工，過去一開案就全速燒腦到極限，問個小問題也找不到原班人馬；現在預設先開高檔位，臨時插話問事照樣由原本分工接手。⟧
body.en:
When `Orchestrator` is enabled to run planning and execution separately, unset roles and newly selected model families previously defaulted to the family's highest thinking level. Now the default `Effort` for `Planner` and `Executor` in the `Orchestrator` row of `/model` is `high`. If `high` is unavailable, it still falls back to that family's highest level.

Your `"orchestrator"` choices saved in `settings.json` remain unchanged.

When asking side questions with `/btw` in these conversations, it previously dropped the plan-and-execute split, and now inherits your configured `Planner` and `Executor` models and `Effort`. ⟦Hiring an architect and a construction crew used to mean running at max brainpower from day one and losing the original team whenever you asked a quick side question; now it starts in a high gear by default, and any quick interruption is still handled by that same split team.⟧

items.original:
Changed the default thinking `Effort` for the `Orchestrator` row's `Planner` and `Executor` roles in `/model` to `high` when available (falling back to the model family's highest offered level otherwise); previously unset roles and newly selected model families defaulted to the family's highest level, such as `xhigh` or `max`. Your saved `"orchestrator"` choices in `settings.json` are unchanged.
Fixed `/btw` side questions in conversations using `Orchestrator` dropping plan-and-execute instead of inheriting your configured `Planner` and `Executor` models and thinking `Effort`.

title.zh-TW: 本機對話紀錄改為預設全部保留
title.en: Local conversations kept by default

body.zh-TW: 以前每次啟動命令列工具，它只會留著最近 `500` 筆本機對話，更早之前的紀錄一啟動就會被刪掉。現在預設會把所有存下來的對話全部保留在 `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations`，不再自動清理舊對話。
body.en: Previously, each time you launched the CLI, it only kept the `500` most recent local conversations and deleted older records on startup. Now all saved conversations are kept in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations` by default, with no automatic pruning of older ones.

items.original: Changed local conversation storage to keep all saved conversations in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations` by default; previously the CLI pruned older saved conversations beyond the `500` most recent at startup.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁改版專案選擇器與環境切換
title.en: Remote Control project picker and environment switching

body.zh-TW:
打開遠端控制網頁的首頁或新對話窗格找專案，再也不用點進只有三個項目的 `Recent` 分組和層層子選單了。專案選擇器現在改成依最近使用排序的單層可捲動清單，上下滑動就能挑。

如果目前有可用的遠端環境，`This Computer`／`Remote` 選擇器會排在專案選擇器前面。它能依環境篩選專案，並各自記住你在各環境最後用過的專案。想在遠端開啟本機的 GitHub 專案，也能從 `Clone from This Computer` 直接開啟。

⟦整理手機通訊錄時，以前把常用聯絡人塞進三個固定格子再一層層點開，現在直接按最近聯絡順序攤平列出，切換工作或私人帳號還會記住你上回找誰。⟧
body.en:
Opening the home screen or new-conversation panes in the Remote Control browser view to find a project no longer requires clicking through a three-item `Recent` group and nested submenus. The project picker is now a flat, scrollable list sorted by recency that you can simply scroll through.

When remote environments are available, the `This Computer` / `Remote` picker appears ahead of the project picker. It filters projects by environment and remembers the last project you used in each one. You can also open local GitHub projects remotely right from `Clone from This Computer`.

⟦Think of organizing your phone contacts: instead of stuffing frequent contacts into three fixed slots behind nested menus, they are now laid out flat by most recent call, and switching between work and personal accounts still remembers who you last looked up.⟧

items.original: Improved the project picker on the home screen and new-conversation panes of the Remote Control browser view: it now shows a flat, scrollable list of projects sorted by recency instead of a three-item `Recent` group and nested submenus, and when remote environments are available, places the `This Computer` / `Remote` picker ahead of the project picker to filter projects by environment, remember your last-used project in each one, and open local GitHub projects remotely from `Clone from This Computer`.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁排隊訊息卡顯示正在等的任務
title.en: Remote Control queued-messages card shows waiting tasks

body.zh-TW:
用瀏覽器介面發新訊息給代理，主回覆寫完但背景還有工作沒結束，以前畫面上只會寫著 `Sends after agent finishes working`。現在排隊訊息卡的標題改顯示 `Waiting on ...`，並列出活躍中的子代理數量，以及最多兩個非 `daemon`（長期在背景常駐執行的小程式）背景任務或計時器的標題。

至於開發伺服器這類背景常駐任務不會卡住排隊佇列，你隨時按下 `Send Now` 也照樣能立刻送出訊息。

⟦排隊等銀行櫃檯叫號時，以前告示只寫「服務中請稍候」，現在會直接顯示前面有幾位行員在忙、正在等哪兩份文件；旁邊一直運轉的冷氣機不算在內，急件一樣能立刻送出。⟧
body.en:
When you send a new message to the agent from the browser view after the main reply finishes while background work is still running, the screen previously only showed `Sends after agent finishes working`. Now the queued-messages card header shows `Waiting on ...`, listing the active subagent count and the titles of up to two non-`daemon` (a small program that runs persistently in the background) background tasks or timers.

Meanwhile, persistent background tasks such as dev servers do not hold up the queue, and pressing `Send Now` still sends your message right away.

⟦Waiting in line at a bank counter used to show a sign that only said "Please wait," whereas now it shows how many tellers are busy ahead of you and which two documents are still pending; the air conditioner humming nearby does not count, and urgent requests still go through immediately.⟧

items.original: Improved the queued-messages card in the Remote Control browser view when the agent's main turn has finished but background work is still holding the queue: instead of `Sends after agent finishes working`, the header now shows `Waiting on ...` with the active subagent count and up to two non-daemon background task or timer titles, while daemon tasks such as dev servers don't hold the queue and `Send Now` still sends right away.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制權限視窗用粗體標示放行目標
title.en: Remote Control permission prompts bold target scope

body.zh-TW:
授權代理操作檔案或執行指令前，最怕整排選項文字一樣細、看不清到底放行了哪裡。遠端控制網頁的權限確認提示現在會把「`always allow`（永遠允許）」選項標籤裡的目標資料夾路徑、指令樣式或網域名稱加粗。

你在視窗裡修改目標內容時，粗體標示也會跟著即時更新，這條規則放行的範圍一眼就能看清。
body.en:
Before granting the agent permission to touch files or run commands, uniform text across options makes it easy to miss what you are actually allowing. Permission prompts in the Remote Control browser view now bold the target folder path, command pattern, or domain inside `"always allow"` option labels.

As you edit the target in the prompt, the bolding updates live so the scope a rule grants stands out at a glance.

items.original: Improved permission prompts in the Remote Control browser view by bolding the target folder path, command pattern, or domain in "always allow" option labels — updating live when you edit the target — so the scope a rule grants stands out at a glance.

title.zh-TW: tokyo night 配色提高文字對比度
title.en: Higher text contrast in tokyo night

body.zh-TW: 選用 `tokyo night` 配色主題時，展開的思考過程、工具輸出和調暗的提示文字以前容易跟代理回覆混在一起。現在調整了文字對比度，這些區塊能清楚和代理的正式回覆區分開來，同時保持好讀。
body.en: When using the `tokyo night` color scheme, expanded thoughts, tool output, and dimmed hints previously blended too easily into agent responses. Adjusted text contrast now keeps those sections clearly distinct from the agent's main replies while remaining easy to read.

items.original: Improved text contrast in the `tokyo night` color scheme so expanded thoughts, tool output, and dimmed hints stand apart from agent responses while staying easy to read.

title.zh-TW: /config 終端機警告誤報與說明截斷修好
title.en: /config terminal warnings and truncated descriptions fixed

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 的終端機打開 `/config` 查看 `Rendering Mode`，以前常看到誤報警告或被切掉的說明文字。

Windows PowerShell 或 Command Prompt 主控台沒有設 `TERM` 時，過去會誤報 `⚠ terminal does not support alt screen`。這個誤報已經修好。

`Rendering Mode` 像 `⚠ alt screen unavailable — run ssh -t` 這類警告，以前會用暗字和設定說明黏在一起。找不到終端機名稱時還會寫成 `terminal "unknown"`，超過三行的多行設定說明也會被截斷，這些顯示問題現在都修好了。
body.en:
Opening `/config` in a Windows terminal to check `Rendering Mode` previously often showed false warnings or cut-off descriptions.

When `TERM` was unset in Windows PowerShell or Command Prompt consoles, it used to falsely warn `⚠ terminal does not support alt screen`. That false warning is now fixed.

`Rendering Mode` warnings such as `⚠ alt screen unavailable — run ssh -t` also used to run right into the setting description in dim text. It would also say `terminal "unknown"` when the terminal name was unavailable, and cut off multi-line setting descriptions past three lines; all of these display issues are now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed `/config` showing a false `⚠ terminal does not support alt screen` warning under `Rendering Mode` in Windows PowerShell and Command Prompt consoles when `TERM` is unset.
Fixed `/config` running `Rendering Mode` warnings (such as `⚠ alt screen unavailable — run ssh -t`) into the setting description in dim text, saying `terminal "unknown"` when the terminal name is unavailable, and cutting off multi-line setting descriptions past three lines.

title.zh-TW: agy acp 編輯器載入與回合狀態修好
title.en: agy acp editor loading and turn state fixed

body.zh-TW:
透過 `agy acp` 把寫程式工具接上代理後，過去常碰到對話紀錄讀不完、夾帶附件讓指令失靈，或是工作還沒跑完就提前結束。

載入長對話會等歷史重播完才回覆，不再滿 2 秒就截斷。接上執行中工作階段會保留權限與提問提示，找不到工作階段 ID 改回 `-32002` 錯誤碼，不再回 `-32603`。

先附加檔案、選取區、圖片或連結再打 `/plan`、`/compact` 等斜線指令或 skill，不會再被跳過。`0` 位元組空檔會保留，網址與帶行號資源連結不再被當成本機路徑。

主回覆寫完時若還有子代理或非 `daemon` 任務在跑，回合會跨過背景喚醒等它們完成並回報合計 `token` 用量。開發伺服器這類常駐任務仍立刻結束回合。

中斷或取消回合時，進行中的工具呼叫不再卡在編輯器裡。沒產出指令或差異的失敗工具呼叫，現在也會附上錯誤訊息。
body.en:
When connecting an editor to the agent through `agy acp`, conversations often failed to finish loading history, attachments broke commands, or turns ended before work was done.

Loading long conversations now waits for history replay to finish instead of cutting off after 2 seconds. Attaching to a running session preserves active permission and question prompts, and a missing session ID now returns error code `-32002` instead of `-32603`.

Leading slash commands or skills such as `/plan` or `/compact` are no longer skipped when files, selections, images, or links are attached ahead of them. Empty `0`-byte files are preserved, and web URLs or line-range resource links are no longer treated as local paths.

If subagents or non-`daemon` tasks are still running when the main reply finishes, the turn now stays open across background wake-ups until they finish and reports the combined `token` usage. Persistent tasks such as dev servers still end the turn right away.

When interrupting or canceling a turn, in-progress tool calls no longer stay stuck open in the editor. Failed tool calls that produced no command or diff output now include error messages as well.

items.original:
Fixed `agy acp` replying to `session/load` before finishing history replay (or cutting off replay after 2 seconds on long conversations), dropping active permission or question prompts when attaching to a running session, and returning JSON-RPC error `-32603` instead of `-32002` when a session ID does not exist.
Fixed `agy acp` skipping leading slash commands or skills (such as `/plan` or `/compact`) when the editor attached files, selections, images, or links ahead of the prompt text, dropping empty (`0`-byte) attached files, and treating web URLs or line-range resource links as local file paths.
Fixed `agy acp` ending a `session/prompt` turn as soon as the agent's initial reply finished while non-daemon background tasks or subagents were still running; the turn now stays open across background wake-ups until that work finishes and reports the combined token usage, while daemon tasks such as dev servers still let the turn end right away.
Fixed `agy acp` leaving in-progress tool calls stuck open in the editor when a turn is interrupted or canceled with `session/cancel`, and omitting error messages on failed tool calls that produced no command or diff output.

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器檢視與開關設定更準確

body.zh-TW:
調整或檢查 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，現在能看到更清楚的狀態與路徑。

在 `/mcps` 裡，除非裡頭超過十台伺服器，否則代管區塊預設會直接展開。

在已經執行的終端機介面工作階段裡，`grok mcp disable` 與 `grok mcp enable` 現在能正確停止對應的伺服器。

執行 `grok inspect` 檢查專案自訂的 MCP 伺服器時，回報的設定檔位置現在能正確對應到 `.grok/config.toml` 或 `.mcp.json`。

這樣一來，清單展開範圍、進行中工作階段的伺服器停用，以及設定檔路徑都跟實際狀態一致。
body.en:
When adjusting or checking MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers, you now see clearer statuses and paths.

In `/mcps`, hosted sections are now expanded by default unless they contain more than ten servers.

Inside already-running terminal UI sessions, `grok mcp disable` and `grok mcp enable` now properly stop the corresponding servers.

When running `grok inspect` on project-defined MCP servers, the reported config file location now accurately points to `.grok/config.toml` or `.mcp.json`.

As a result, list expansion scope, stopping servers in active sessions, and config file paths all match the actual state.

`grok mcp disable` (and enable) now correctly stops servers inside already-running TUI sessions
`grok inspect` now reports the correct project `.grok/config.toml` or `.mcp.json` file for project-defined MCP servers

Turning a built-in skill on or off, or resetting it, removes the other spellings of it from that settings file
Resuming a session that ended without a clean exit now shows the abnormal-exit warning even when Muse was started again in between
`muse trace inspect` says when a session log holds no per-lane samples for a request, and still checks the request against its replay
When a shell command runs without a Git directory that was swapped for a symlink, the agent is told which directory moved and how to make it usable again
Background command notices, Monitor events and fetched web pages that had to be cut now name the saved full output in the same `<persisted-output>` block

After a long conversation is compacted, the commands it keeps from earlier work are real commands, not file or log lines that only mention a command word mid-line; commands the agent ran itself are left to the written summary

`muse plugins validate` and `muse plugins install` now say a plugin manifest's `formerUnits` field is ignored (`ignored-former-units`), because only plugins that ship in the product can take over a former plugin's settings; the plugin still installs and its skills and hooks still work
When you name a skill by its short name and only an installed plugin shares that name with a built-in skill, Muse opens the built-in skill instead of asking you to choose
When your own user or project skill has the same name as a built-in skill, the TUI says so at startup and shows the `bundled:<name>` id that still opens the built-in
`muse plugins inspect` lists each built-in skill by the id the skills list uses, such as `bundled:plan`, instead of a plugin-qualified id
Security: Goal cards no longer print raw terminal control sequences hidden in goal text
Security: Writes to `~/.npmrc`, `~/.pypirc`, `~/.docker/config.json` or `~/.kube/config` now ask for approval before Muse changes them
Security: Installed plugin hooks ask for review again when an update changes the code they run, and hooks you approved before this release ask once more

The `run.usage` line of `muse exec --json` now counts every model call of the run; after a context compaction inside the run it counted only the later calls. When exec cannot count the whole run, it leaves the line out and prints a notice to stderr

When a new session's log is deleted while the session starts, the start now stops and says so, instead of writing a new log without the session's permission settings that a later `--session-id` run would pick up

Long sessions that run many Workflows no longer stop saving checkpoints: once a Workflow has ended, its finished subagents drop out of the saved session instead of being carried in every later checkpoint
`muse serve` now applies `-c` overrides such as `-c model_catalog=[]` to the model list it serves, not only when `--preset` is given
A session can still message another local session after an earlier session that messaged it from the same app has closed
Stopping a run or subagent just before its tool calls start, with a `PreToolUse` hook configured, now ends it as cancelled instead of failed with "tool batch ended without result"

A forked session hosted by `muse serve` no longer loses its own earlier turns from what the model sees; from the fork's third turn on, the model was sent the turns inherited from the parent, the fork's first turn and the newest message, but none of the fork's turns in between

In a sandboxed shell under the ProxyOnly network mode, an approved plain-HTTP request to a server that closes on an early client half-close now receives that server's response instead of an empty reply
The web3d skill's page checker takes phone screenshots at device scale 1 on a software renderer, so they time out far less often
Listing sessions no longer hangs when the session index is upgraded in the middle of the request

Starting Muse no longer writes into your earlier sessions' files, so a session that a file-sync tool copies between machines is no longer refused with "the session log was replaced by another file outside Muse"

A terminal or `tbh exec` session started with `--no-session-log`, including a read-only resume, no longer writes the built-in skill and plugin caches into your data folder; it reuses them when they are already there and otherwise keeps a temporary copy that is removed when it exits
On Windows, symbols such as ✓, →, € and —, combining accents, emoji joiners and variation selectors are no longer dropped from what you type or paste into the composer

On Windows, a corrupt session index is now set aside and rebuilt from your session logs, so `/resume` stops scanning every saved session each time it opens and you no longer have to delete the file by hand
On Windows, `--worktree create` now creates the session worktree instead of failing while Git writes the new worktree's `.git` file
On Windows, when the agent tries to read a folder as a file, the listing command it is pointed to now works for folder names with spaces, quotes or non-ASCII characters
Reopening a session no longer leaves out a turn that started while a session checkpoint or a context compaction was being saved
A Workflow agent or an Auto-review reviewer that has stopped responding is now ended 30 seconds after it is cancelled, instead of staying open indefinitely
A command or MCP server that a session starts and leaves running can no longer stop `muse serve` or `muse acp` from indexing history for rewind
A turn waiting on a monitor or background task no longer wakes for an update the model already received
When a turn dies unexpectedly while a tool call is still starting, that tool task now ends as failed instead of staying open forever
Sessions that switch model providers keep working after a crash resume; sessions saved by earlier builds are unchanged
Pressing Esc right after sending a prompt in a long session no longer shows the prompt in the composer and above the status row at the same time
Nested subagents report their true depth in the subagent roster and in subagent items, so a grandchild no longer reads as a direct child
Resuming a session no longer shows a false "runtime closed before context compaction completed" error after a `/compact` whose result could not be saved

When a streaming endpoint answers with no Content-Type header at all, the run now keeps retrying briefly before failing, matching how a transitory proxy rewrite of the header behaves; a page explicitly labelled with a non-SSE content type still fails at once
Stopping a Workflow at the moment it finishes no longer leaves it shown as `unresolved`

`exec --json` lines now carry a unique `id` and the real `recorded_at` time instead of the same placeholder ids and fixed 2026-06-04 times in every run, so scripts can join and time runs from the JSONL output
A `!` command that ends while the session finishes an automatic context compaction in the background no longer fails and loses its output when a tool hook ran for it

When the model service is overloaded (HTTP 503) or times out (HTTP 504), the first retry, and any retry wait the server does not set, now varies a little between sessions, so fewer sessions retry at the same moment and pile onto a service that is already busy

A fork or side chat of a compacted session hosted by `muse serve` now starts from everything the session did after the compaction; a fork could be sent a redundant note restating its delegation settings, and in rarer cases a fork or side chat started without the session's newest turns
After a context compaction in a session that does not write its own session log, a repeated subagent start no longer fails its lookup of the first start
Forked conversations preserve accepted followup turns
Automations that saved a subagent result the app could not finish storing need a newer app version to resume
Large images returned by MCP tools are now resized and re-encoded the same way as images read from files, so a few big tool images no longer make every later request too large
The queue key now keeps command intent when the command trigger is remapped, so a remapped exit or clear during a run acts as the command instead of queueing its text
Preserve exit status and output in notifications for long background commands
When a Workflow subagent's run fails after it has completed model calls, the tokens of those completed calls now count in the Workflow's token total and against a token budget you set
A shell command that fails with sandbox guidance longer than the output limit keeps its saved output and reports that the message was shortened

After a crash, when the session could only reopen from its last checkpoint, the startup notice now lists the tool calls and `!` commands the resume had already cancelled before it fell back to that checkpoint

When a new session's log is deleted while a client starts the session through the session server (`session/start`), the start now stops and says the log was deleted, instead of writing a new log without the session's permission settings
When settings.json cannot be read, skill activation defaults to off for that run instead of silently re-enabling skills the unreadable file had turned off
`/compact` in a session whose latest turn included a pasted image now compacts the conversation instead of refusing it as an invalid target
A full-context fork taken after switching model providers keeps working; forks saved by earlier builds are unchanged

On case-insensitive mounts such as WSL2 DrvFs, Muse's file tools now resolve protected files like `auth.json` and `trust.json` to the file they actually name, so opening the same file through a differently-cased path (for example `MUSE/auth.json`) is denied just like the exact spelling; a sandboxed shell refuses to start when a denied file lives on such a mount, because no path mask can cover the alias

The TUI no longer stops reading keys and drawing while the subagent workspace check waits for a session record to reach a slow disk; on a busy machine this froze the TUI for seconds at a time during turns and subagent runs
A session started with `/new` or `/clear` now saves session checkpoints; before, it saved none, so reopening it after a context compaction read its whole history
When hooks stop a turn on more than one tool call of a batch, a stop on a call that a `PostToolUseFailure` hook corrected with `updatedInput` no longer replaces the stop reason of an earlier call
Auth and trust file locks now sit beside the resolved write destination, so a symlinked auth.json or trust.json shares one lock across every spelling instead of two

A hook from a settings or hooks file that runs when a session starts, resumes, clears, compacts or forks no longer leaves a record in the session log when it exits 0, writes nothing but whitespace to stderr and adds or changes nothing (no context, system message or error); any other run of these hooks is recorded when it ends, and runs of a plugin's hook at these events are recorded as before; plain text that a hook prints to stdout when a session starts, resumes, clears, compacts or forks, or when a subagent starts, becomes context, so that run is recorded
Session logs on disk are smaller, because each model request now writes a shorter trace entry
Starting a new turn in a long session no longer re-reads the records of every earlier turn

A `Stop` hook no longer leaves a record in the session log when it exits 0, writes nothing but whitespace to stderr and adds or changes nothing (it does not keep the turn going, add a system message or fail); any other run of a `Stop` hook is recorded when it ends

title.zh-TW: exec --list-models 列出模型清單
title.en: exec --list-models lists available models

body.zh-TW: 在終端機執行 `exec` 卻不小心打錯 `--model` 的名稱，不用退出畫面也能補救。執行 `exec --list-models` 會一行一個印出供應商提供的所有模型 ID，照著改對再重跑即可。⟦就像在飲料店唸錯品項時，直接看一眼櫃檯價目表，就能立刻改點正確的那一杯。⟧
body.en: If you run `exec` in the terminal and mistype the `--model` name, you can fix it without leaving the screen. Running `exec --list-models` prints every model ID your provider offers, one per line, so you can correct it and rerun. ⟦Picture mispronouncing a drink name at a beverage shop: one glance at the counter menu lets you immediately reorder the right cup.⟧

items.original: `exec --list-models` prints the model IDs your provider offers, one per line, so a mistyped `--model` is recoverable without leaving the terminal

title.zh-TW: 太久的 MCP 呼叫可先轉入背景執行
title.en: Move slow MCP calls to the background

body.zh-TW: 遇到某個 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具呼叫跑太久，現在不必乾等它卡住整個對話。按下 `Ctrl+B` 或直接送出下一則訊息，這個呼叫就會轉入背景繼續跑，等它跑完，結果會自動接回原本的對話裡。⟦好比在餐廳點了需要現做的餐點，拿到震動叫號器就能先回座位聊天，不用一直罰站等在櫃檯前。⟧
body.en: When an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tool call takes too long, you no longer have to sit and wait while it blocks the whole conversation. Press `Ctrl+B` or simply send your next message to move the call into the background, and its result will rejoin the conversation once it finishes. ⟦Think of ordering a made-to-order dish at a restaurant: once they hand you a buzzer, you can head back to your table and chat instead of standing by the counter.⟧

items.original: A slow MCP tool call can move to the background with Ctrl+B or when you send another message, and its result joins the conversation when it finishes

title.zh-TW: 技能與驗證提醒改為預設關閉
title.en: Skill and verify reminders are now off by default

items.original: The skill and verify reminders are now off by default, so turns end without the verify check's wait and sessions spend fewer tokens on skill suggestions. Turn either back on in `/plugins` or by setting `plugins.skill-reminder.enabled` or `plugins.verify-reminder.enabled` to `true` in `settings.json`

title.zh-TW: 過長輸出統一改用截斷與存檔區塊呈現
title.en: Long output now uses unified truncation and saved blocks

body.zh-TW:
跑指令、讀檔或抓網頁一次吐出大量內容時，對話視窗常被塞滿。

指令的過長輸出改以 `<persisted-output>` 或 `<truncated-output>` 區塊傳給模型，顯示頭尾內容與略過大小。

讀檔、搜尋等工具的過長輸出，會用簡短的 `<persisted-output>` 區塊標出完整檔案，無法存檔時改用 `<truncated-output>`。

截斷的背景指令通知、Monitor 事件與抓取網頁，也在 `<persisted-output>` 區塊列出完整存檔。

終端機指令失敗且沙盒指引超過上限時，會保留已儲存的輸出，並回報訊息已縮短。⟦如同收到幾百頁的厚重紙本報告時，郵差只先遞給你附頭尾摘要的索引單，完整原文則收進檔案櫃供隨時調閱。⟧
body.en:
When running a command, reading a file, or fetching a web page dumps a lot of content at once, the chat window often gets flooded.

Long command output now goes to the model in a `<persisted-output>` or `<truncated-output>` block, showing the beginning, the end, and the size of the omitted part.

Long output from file reads, searches, and other tools uses a short `<persisted-output>` block pointing to the full file, or `<truncated-output>` when nothing can be saved.

Truncated background command notices, Monitor events, and fetched web pages also list the saved full file in a `<persisted-output>` block.

When a terminal command fails and the sandbox guidance exceeds the limit, the saved output is kept and the message reports that it was shortened. ⟦A courier handing over a massive paper report works the same way: you first get an index sheet with the opening and closing summary, while the full original goes into a filing cabinet for whenever you want to pull it.⟧

items.original:
Long command output now reaches the model in the same `<persisted-output>` or `<truncated-output>` block, showing its start and end and the size of the part left out
Long output from file reads, searches and other tools now reaches the model as a short `<persisted-output>` block that names the file holding the full output, or a `<truncated-output>` block when nothing could be saved
Background command notices, Monitor events and fetched web pages that had to be cut now name the saved full output in the same `<persisted-output>` block
A shell command that fails with sandbox guidance longer than the output limit keeps its saved output and reports that the message was shortened

title.zh-TW: 內建技能新舊代號與企業名單規則更新
title.en: Updated built-in skill IDs and enterprise list rules

body.zh-TW:
在設定檔、受管技能檔或企業允許與封鎖清單裡，現在都能寫入內建技能的 `bundled:<id>` 與舊寫法。寫進 `allowed_identities` 的技能不管 `allowed_sources` 設定都會放行，想保留特定技能直接列在這裡即可。該處若寫舊寫法只代表內建技能而不含同名使用者技能，但寫進 `denied_identities` 則兩者都擋。

受管技能檔若把同一技能寫了兩次，例如新舊寫法並存或同時列出 `plugin:<pkg>:<skill>` 與路徑，該檔案仍會保留。兩邊設定值相同就照常套用，互相衝突就會關閉該技能並跳出列出兩個鍵名的警告。開關或重設內建技能時，設定檔裡其他寫法也會跟著移除。⟦彷彿公司換發新式員工證時，舊編號仍暫時通用，但只要同一人的兩張通行證權限打架，門禁就會先鎖卡並通知管理員。⟧
body.en:
In settings files, managed skill files, or enterprise allow and deny lists, you can now specify a built-in skill using `bundled:<id>` or its older spellings. Skills listed in `allowed_identities` are admitted regardless of `allowed_sources`, so you can list any specific skill there to keep it available. An older spelling in `allowed_identities` refers only to the built-in skill and not a user skill with the same name, whereas in `denied_identities` it blocks both.

If a managed skill file lists the same skill twice, such as mixing old and new spellings or placing `plugin:<pkg>:<skill>` alongside its path, the file is still kept. Matching values apply as normal, while conflicting values turn that skill off and raise a warning naming both keys. Turning a built-in skill on or off, or resetting it, also removes its other spellings from that settings file. ⟦Imagine a company issuing new staff badges where old ID numbers still work for now, yet the moment one person's two passes have conflicting permissions, the door system locks the card and alerts an admin.⟧

items.original: Settings, managed skill files and enterprise allow and deny lists accept a built-in skill's `bundled:<id>` name and its older spellings, and a skill named in `allowed_identities` is admitted whatever `allowed_sources` says (an older spelling there names only the built-in skill, never a user skill of that name, while in `denied_identities` it refuses both); name a skill there to keep it available whatever its source. A managed skill file that names one skill twice (two spellings, or a plugin skill's `plugin:<pkg>:<skill>` id beside its path) is kept: matching values apply, and conflicting values turn that skill off with a warning naming both keys. Turning a built-in skill on or off, or resetting it, removes the other spellings of it from that settings file

title.zh-TW: 技能撞名時明確分辨並改列內建代號
title.en: Clearer handling and built-in IDs for skill name collisions

body.zh-TW:
自訂或外掛技能跟內建技能取了一樣的短名稱，新版把優先順序與代號標示清楚了。

呼叫短名稱時如果只有已安裝外掛跟內建技能撞名，Muse 會直接開啟內建技能，不再跳出來要你二選一。

如果是你自己的使用者或專案技能跟內建技能同名，終端機介面會在啟動時主動提醒，並告訴你用 `bundled:<name>` 這個代號依然能打開內建版。

執行 `muse plugins inspect` 檢視外掛時，內建技能現在也會照技能清單的格式列出如 `bundled:plan` 的代號，不再顯示帶外掛前綴的 ID。
body.en:
When a custom or plugin skill shares a short name with a built-in skill, the new version makes the precedence and ID clear.

If you invoke a short name and only an installed plugin collides with a built-in skill, Muse opens the built-in skill directly instead of asking you to choose.

If your own user or project skill has the same name as a built-in skill, the terminal UI alerts you at startup and shows that `bundled:<name>` still opens the built-in version.

When running `muse plugins inspect`, built-in skills now use the same ID format as the skills list, such as `bundled:plan`, instead of a plugin-prefixed ID.

items.original:
When you name a skill by its short name and only an installed plugin shares that name with a built-in skill, Muse opens the built-in skill instead of asking you to choose
When your own user or project skill has the same name as a built-in skill, the TUI says so at startup and shows the `bundled:<name>` id that still opens the built-in
`muse plugins inspect` lists each built-in skill by the id the skills list uses, such as `bundled:plan`, instead of a plugin-qualified id

title.zh-TW: 外掛檢查與安裝明確提示略過舊繼承欄位
title.en: Plugin validation and install clearly note ignored formerUnits

body.zh-TW: 外掛作者或管理員使用 `muse plugins validate` 與 `muse plugins install` 時，若資訊檔帶有 `formerUnits` 欄位，現在會看到 `ignored-former-units` 提示。因為只有隨產品內建的外掛能接手舊外掛的設定，這個欄位會被略過。不過外掛依然會完成安裝，裡面的技能和 hook（特定事件發生時會被觸發的小程式）都能照常運作。⟦就像拿舊門牌去新社區報到，管理室會跳過那張舊證件不認帳，但照樣讓你辦好入住、屋裡的家電都能正常用。⟧
body.en: When plugin authors or admins run `muse plugins validate` or `muse plugins install`, a manifest containing a `formerUnits` field now displays an `ignored-former-units` notice. Because only plugins bundled with the product can take over a former plugin's settings, this field is ignored. The plugin still finishes installing, and its skills and hooks (small programs triggered when specific events happen) continue to work normally. ⟦Suppose you check into a new apartment complex with an old street-number plate: the management office ignores that outdated card, yet still checks you in so all the appliances inside work fine.⟧

items.original: `muse plugins validate` and `muse plugins install` now say a plugin manifest's `formerUnits` field is ignored (`ignored-former-units`), because only plugins that ship in the product can take over a former plugin's settings; the plugin still installs and its skills and hooks still work

title.zh-TW: 讀不到 settings.json 時預設關閉技能
title.en: Skills default to off when settings.json is unreadable

body.zh-TW: 如果 `settings.json` 暫時無法讀取，過去會默默把你在那份檔案裡關閉的技能重新啟用。現在只要讀不到 `settings.json`，該次執行的技能啟用狀態一律預設為關閉，不再意外打開已停用的技能。
body.en: Previously, if `settings.json` was temporarily unreadable, skills you had disabled in that file were silently re-enabled. Now, whenever `settings.json` cannot be read, skill activation defaults to off for that run so disabled skills are never turned back on by mistake.

items.original: When settings.json cannot be read, skill activation defaults to off for that run instead of silently re-enabling skills the unreadable file had turned off

title.zh-TW: 目標卡過濾隱藏的終端機控制碼
title.en: Goal cards filter hidden terminal control codes

body.zh-TW: 打開目標檢視畫面時，文字裡若夾帶了不該直接顯示的指令，過去會原封不動被印出來。現在目標卡不再輸出這些藏在目標文字裡的原始終端機控制序列。
body.en: Previously, when opening the goal view, any hidden instructions embedded in the text were printed as-is. Goal cards now strip out these raw terminal control sequences hidden inside goal text.

items.original: Security: Goal cards no longer print raw terminal control sequences hidden in goal text

title.zh-TW: 修改指定四種設定檔前先徵求核准
title.en: Ask for approval before modifying four specified config files

body.zh-TW: Muse 準備寫入 `~/.npmrc`、`~/.pypirc`、`~/.docker/config.json` 或 `~/.kube/config` 之前，現在會先徵求你的核准才會修改。⟦有如請幫手整理書桌時，一般文件可以自行歸位，遇到放存摺和印章的抽屜一定要先問過你才敢動手。⟧
body.en: Before Muse writes to `~/.npmrc`, `~/.pypirc`, `~/.docker/config.json`, or `~/.kube/config`, it now asks for your approval first. ⟦When you ask an assistant to tidy your desk, everyday papers can be put away on their own, while the drawer holding your bankbooks and personal seals stays untouched until they ask you first.⟧

items.original: Security: Writes to `~/.npmrc`, `~/.pypirc`, `~/.docker/config.json` or `~/.kube/config` now ask for approval before Muse changes them

title.zh-TW: 外掛 hook 執行程式碼變動後須重審
title.en: Plugin hooks require re-review after code changes

body.zh-TW: 已安裝的外掛在更新後若改動了執行的程式碼，裡面的 hook 都會再次請你審查確認。你在這一版之前就核准過的 hook，這次也會再詢問確認一次。⟦換作社區物業調整了巡邏或門禁合約，就算住戶去年簽過同意書，今年換新內容還是得請你重新過目簽字。⟧
body.en: When an update changes the code an installed plugin runs, its hooks will ask for your review again. Hooks you approved before this release will also ask for confirmation once more. ⟦A neighborhood property manager revising a patrol or gate-access contract still has to ask residents to read and sign the new terms, even if they signed a consent form last year.⟧

items.original: Security: Installed plugin hooks ask for review again when an update changes the code they run, and hooks you approved before this release ask once more

title.zh-TW: 強化保護檔在別名與捷徑下的存取鎖定
title.en: Stronger access locks for protected files via aliases and symlinks

body.zh-TW:
在 WSL2 DrvFs 這類不區分大小寫的掛載磁區上，檔案工具現在會把 `auth.json`、`trust.json` 等受保護檔案解析到實際位置。即使改用不同大小寫的路徑像是 `MUSE/auth.json` 開啟，也會和原本拼法一樣被拒絕。如果被拒絕的檔案位於這類磁區，沙盒終端機也會因為路徑遮罩無法涵蓋所有別名而拒絕啟動。

`auth.json` 與 `trust.json` 的檔案鎖現在改放在解析後的實際寫入位置旁，因此透過 symlink（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）存取時，各種寫法都會共用同一把鎖，不再各鎖各的。⟦好比替同一間保險箱掛了大小寫不同的門牌與捷徑，以前換個寫法就認不出來，現在全認準同一扇門與同一把鎖。⟧
body.en:
On case-insensitive mounts such as WSL2 DrvFs, file tools now resolve protected files like `auth.json` and `trust.json` to their actual location. Opening one through a differently cased path such as `MUSE/auth.json` is denied just like the exact spelling. If a denied file resides on such a mount, the sandboxed terminal also refuses to start because path masks cannot cover every alias.

File locks for `auth.json` and `trust.json` now sit beside the resolved write destination, so accessing them through a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location) makes every spelling share one lock instead of locking separately. ⟦Hanging differently cased doorplates and shortcuts on the same vault used to make it unrecognizable under another spelling, whereas now everything points to the same door and the same lock.⟧

items.original:
On case-insensitive mounts such as WSL2 DrvFs, Muse's file tools now resolve protected files like `auth.json` and `trust.json` to the file they actually name, so opening the same file through a differently-cased path (for example `MUSE/auth.json`) is denied just like the exact spelling; a sandboxed shell refuses to start when a denied file lives on such a mount, because no path mask can cover the alias
Auth and trust file locks now sit beside the resolved write destination, so a symlinked auth.json or trust.json shares one lock across every spelling instead of two

title.zh-TW: exec --json 補齊用量與真實時間
title.en: exec --json completes usage counts and real timestamps

body.zh-TW:
寫自動化腳本剖析 `muse exec --json` 輸出，過去常因重複編號、固定日期與漏算呼叫次數而失真。

`run.usage` 那一行現在會統計整趟執行的每一次模型呼叫，不再因為中途做過上下文壓縮就只算後半段。如果無法統計整趟執行，則會略過該行並將通知印到標準錯誤。

`exec --json` 的每一行現在都會帶上唯一的 `id` 和真實的 `recorded_at` 時間，取代過去重複的佔位編號與固定的 `2026-06-04` 時間。這樣腳本就能直接依據 JSONL 輸出串接資料並計算耗時。⟦跟結帳收據補上每張獨立單號與真實刷卡時間一樣，中間就算換過紙捲，整筆消費也能對得清清楚楚。⟧
body.en:
Automation scripts parsing `muse exec --json` output used to get skewed results from duplicate IDs, a fixed date, and missed call counts.

The `run.usage` line now counts every model call across the entire run, rather than only counting the later half after a mid-run context compaction. If the whole run cannot be counted, that line is omitted and a notice is printed to stderr.

Each `exec --json` line now carries a unique `id` and the real `recorded_at` time, replacing the repeated placeholder IDs and fixed `2026-06-04` timestamp. Scripts can now join data and calculate durations directly from the JSONL output. ⟦Just as checkout receipts gain individual receipt numbers and real card-swipe timestamps, the entire purchase reconciles cleanly even if the paper roll is swapped mid-transaction.⟧

items.original:
The `run.usage` line of `muse exec --json` now counts every model call of the run; after a context compaction inside the run it counted only the later calls. When exec cannot count the whole run, it leaves the line out and prints a notice to stderr
`exec --json` lines now carry a unique `id` and the real `recorded_at` time instead of the same placeholder ids and fixed 2026-06-04 times in every run, so scripts can join and time runs from the JSONL output

title.zh-TW: 啟動時若紀錄檔被刪會立刻中止不重寫
title.en: Startup aborts instead of rewriting if the log is deleted

body.zh-TW:
新工作階段啟動過程如果紀錄檔被刪掉，過去會重寫一份沒有原本權限設定的新紀錄檔，讓之後的 `--session-id` 讀到錯誤設定。

現在無論是直接啟動，還是透過工作階段伺服器執行 `session/start` 啟動，只要紀錄檔在啟動中途被刪除，就會立刻中止並提示該檔案已遭刪除。這樣就不會再產生一份缺少原本權限設定的新紀錄檔。⟦像門禁名單剛開好卻被抽走時，警衛寧可當場喊停也不隨便補發空白通行證，免得之後放錯人進門。⟧
body.en:
If a new session's log file was deleted during startup, it used to rewrite a new log without the original permission settings, causing a later `--session-id` run to read the wrong configuration.

Now, whether started directly or via `session/start` through the session server, startup immediately aborts and reports that the log file was deleted if it disappears mid-start. This prevents creating a new log missing the original permission settings. ⟦Once a freshly prepared access list goes missing, a guard halts entry on the spot rather than handing out blank passes that could let the wrong person in later.⟧

items.original:
When a new session's log is deleted while the session starts, the start now stops and says so, instead of writing a new log without the session's permission settings that a later `--session-id` run would pick up
When a new session's log is deleted while a client starts the session through the session server (`session/start`), the start now stops and says the log was deleted, instead of writing a new log without the session's permission settings

title.zh-TW: 異常退出與當機後接續工作階段更完整
title.en: More complete session resumes after abnormal exits and crashes

body.zh-TW:
工作階段中途當機或非正常結束後想接著做，這批修復讓檢查點保存與啟動提示更可靠。

沒正常退出就結束的工作階段，就算中間重開過 Muse，接續時依然會看到異常退出的警告。

重開工作階段時，剛好在儲存檢查點或進行上下文壓縮期間開始的那一輪對話，不會再被遺漏。

切換過模型供應商的工作階段在當機接續後能繼續正常使用，舊版本已存下的紀錄則維持不變。

當機後若只能從上一個檢查點重開，啟動通知會列出接續過程退回檢查點前已經取消的工具呼叫與 `!` 指令。

用 `/new` 或 `/clear` 開啟的工作階段現在會儲存檢查點，不像以前完全沒存而導致壓縮後重開得重讀全部歷史。
body.en:
When you need to continue after a mid-session crash or abnormal exit, these fixes make checkpoint saving and startup notices more reliable.

Resuming a session that ended without a clean exit still shows the abnormal-exit warning, even if Muse was restarted in between.

Reopening a session no longer drops a turn that started while a checkpoint was being saved or a context compaction was running.

Sessions that switched model providers continue working normally after a crash resume, while logs saved by earlier builds remain unchanged.

After a crash, when a session can only reopen from its last checkpoint, the startup notice lists the tool calls and `!` commands that were already cancelled before falling back to that checkpoint.

Sessions started with `/new` or `/clear` now save checkpoints, instead of saving none and forcing a full history re-read when reopened after compaction.

items.original:
Resuming a session that ended without a clean exit now shows the abnormal-exit warning even when Muse was started again in between
Reopening a session no longer leaves out a turn that started while a session checkpoint or a context compaction was being saved
Sessions that switch model providers keep working after a crash resume; sessions saved by earlier builds are unchanged
After a crash, when the session could only reopen from its last checkpoint, the startup notice now lists the tool calls and `!` commands the resume had already cancelled before it fell back to that checkpoint
A session started with `/new` or `/clear` now saves session checkpoints; before, it saved none, so reopening it after a context compaction read its whole history

title.zh-TW: 工作階段紀錄縮減體積並修好跨機同步
title.en: Smaller session logs and fixed cross-machine sync

body.zh-TW:
在兩台電腦之間搬移對話紀錄，或對話越積越長時，以往容易碰到檔案衝突、查詢卡住與硬碟佔用過大的問題。這幾項讀取與寫入行為都已經調整改善。

查詢工作階段清單時剛好遇上索引升級，現在不會再卡住不動。

啟動 Muse 不會再改寫先前的工作階段檔案。透過檔案同步工具跨機複製的紀錄，也不再跳出「the session log was replaced by another file outside Muse」而遭拒絕。

由於每次模型請求寫入的追蹤紀錄更精簡，硬碟上的工作階段紀錄檔也跟著變小。

在長工作階段裡開始新一輪對話時，不用再把前面每一輪的紀錄全部重讀一遍。
body.en:
Moving conversation logs between two computers or letting sessions grow long used to cause file conflicts, stalled queries, and excessive disk usage. Several read and write behaviors have now been improved.

Querying the session list no longer hangs when an index upgrade happens at the same time.

Starting Muse no longer modifies earlier session files. Logs copied across machines by a file-sync tool are no longer rejected with "the session log was replaced by another file outside Muse".

Because each model request writes a leaner trace entry, session log files on disk are smaller as well.

Starting a new turn in a long session no longer re-reads the records of every earlier turn.

items.original:
Listing sessions no longer hangs when the session index is upgraded in the middle of the request
Starting Muse no longer writes into your earlier sessions' files, so a session that a file-sync tool copies between machines is no longer refused with "the session log was replaced by another file outside Muse"
Session logs on disk are smaller, because each model request now writes a shorter trace entry
Starting a new turn in a long session no longer re-reads the records of every earlier turn

title.zh-TW: 無紀錄模式不再把快取寫進資料夾
title.en: No-session-log mode stops writing caches to your folder

body.zh-TW: 想開一個不留痕跡的對話或進行唯讀接續，在終端機或 `tbh exec` 加上 `--no-session-log` 參數現在更徹底。這類工作階段不會再把內建技能與外掛的快取（把算過或查過的資料暫存起來直接用的檔案）寫進你的資料夾。如果資料夾裡原本就有就沿用，否則只保留結束時會刪除的暫存副本。⟦像借用朋友電腦開無痕視窗查資料時，只暫用現成工具、不把私人暫存檔塞進他的資料夾，關掉視窗就乾乾淨淨。⟧
body.en: Starting a traceless conversation or a read-only resume with `--no-session-log` in the terminal or `tbh exec` is now more thorough. These sessions no longer write built-in skill and plugin caches into your folder. If they already exist in the folder, they are reused; otherwise, only a temporary copy is kept and deleted on exit. ⟦Borrowing a friend's computer in an incognito window lets you use existing tools without stuffing personal temp files into their folders, leaving everything clean when you close the window.⟧

items.original: A terminal or `tbh exec` session started with `--no-session-log`, including a read-only resume, no longer writes the built-in skill and plugin caches into your data folder; it reuses them when they are already there and otherwise keeps a temporary copy that is removed when it exits

title.zh-TW: 上下文壓縮的保留準則與異常狀況修復
title.en: Context compaction retention rules and edge-case fixes

body.zh-TW:
把長對話壓縮變短的過程，現在更能正確保留指令並避開幾項儲存衝突。

長對話壓縮後保留下來的過去指令，現在只會是實際執行過的指令，不會再誤抓中間剛好提到指令關鍵字的檔案或紀錄行；代理自己跑過的指令則留給文字摘要處理。

執行 `/compact` 卻未能存下結果時，之後接續該工作階段不會再誤報「runtime closed before context compaction completed」錯誤。

在背景完成自動上下文壓縮的同時，若有搭配工具 hook 執行的 `!` 指令剛好結束，現在不會再失敗並遺失輸出。

沒有寫入自身紀錄檔的工作階段在做完上下文壓縮後，重複啟動子代理時不會再找不到第一次啟動的紀錄。

最新一輪對話若包含貼上的圖片，執行 `/compact` 現在會正常壓縮對話，不再把它當成無效對象而拒絕。
body.en:
Compacting long conversations now preserves commands more accurately and avoids several storage conflicts.

Past commands kept after compacting a long conversation are now only commands that were actually run, rather than file or log lines that happen to mention a command keyword mid-line; commands the agent ran itself are left to the written summary.

When `/compact` fails to save its result, resuming that session later no longer shows a false "runtime closed before context compaction completed" error.

If a `!` command running with a tool hook finishes just as automatic context compaction completes in the background, it no longer fails and loses its output.

After context compaction in a session that does not write its own log file, starting a subagent again no longer fails to find the record of its first start.

If the latest turn includes a pasted image, running `/compact` now compacts the conversation normally instead of rejecting it as an invalid target.

items.original:
After a long conversation is compacted, the commands it keeps from earlier work are real commands, not file or log lines that only mention a command word mid-line; commands the agent ran itself are left to the written summary
Resuming a session no longer shows a false "runtime closed before context compaction completed" error after a `/compact` whose result could not be saved
A `!` command that ends while the session finishes an automatic context compaction in the background no longer fails and loses its output when a tool hook ran for it
After a context compaction in a session that does not write its own session log, a repeated subagent start no longer fails its lookup of the first start
`/compact` in a session whose latest turn included a pasted image now compacts the conversation instead of refusing it as an invalid target

title.zh-TW: 分支對話與旁聊能完整保留前後輪脈絡
title.en: Forked sessions and side chats preserve full turn context

body.zh-TW:
從既有對話開出分支或旁聊繼續問下去，模型現在不會再漏看中間講過的內容。

由 `muse serve` 託管的分支工作階段，過去從第三輪開始只會把繼承自母對話的紀錄、分支第一輪與最新訊息送給模型而漏掉中間各輪，現在已經補回。

由 `muse serve` 託管且做過壓縮的工作階段，開出的分支或旁聊現在會從壓縮後的所有操作接續，不再重複收到重申委派設定的冗餘附註，也不會漏掉最新幾輪。

分支對話中已經被接受的後續接問輪次，現在都會妥善保留下來。

切換模型供應商之後建立的完整上下文分支可以繼續正常運作，舊版本儲存的分支則維持原樣。
body.en:
When you branch off an existing conversation into a fork or side chat, the model no longer misses turns in the middle.

Forked sessions hosted by `muse serve` used to send the model only the turns inherited from the parent, the fork's first turn, and the newest message starting from the third turn, dropping the turns in between; those missing turns are now included.

A fork or side chat opened from a compacted session hosted by `muse serve` now continues from everything done after compaction, no longer receives a redundant note restating delegation settings, and no longer drops the newest turns.

Accepted follow-up turns in forked conversations are now properly preserved.

Full-context forks created after switching model providers continue to work normally, while forks saved by earlier builds remain unchanged.

items.original:
A forked session hosted by `muse serve` no longer loses its own earlier turns from what the model sees; from the fork's third turn on, the model was sent the turns inherited from the parent, the fork's first turn and the newest message, but none of the fork's turns in between
A fork or side chat of a compacted session hosted by `muse serve` now starts from everything the session did after the compaction; a fork could be sent a redundant note restating its delegation settings, and in rarer cases a fork or side chat started without the session's newest turns
Forked conversations preserve accepted followup turns
A full-context fork taken after switching model providers keeps working; forks saved by earlier builds are unchanged

title.zh-TW: Workflow 代理清理與額度計算問題修正
title.en: Fixes for Workflow agent cleanup and token accounting

body.zh-TW:
跑多輪 Workflow 容易遇上的檢查點停存、代理掛起與 token 漏算問題，新版都有對應修正。

Workflow 一旦結束，已完成的子代理就會從儲存的工作階段移出，不再塞進後續每一個檢查點，長工作階段跑很多次 Workflow 也不再因此停存檢查點。

沒有回應的 Workflow 代理或 Auto-review 審查員在取消 30 秒後就會強制結束，不會再無限期掛著。

剛好在 Workflow 快完成的那一刻停止它，狀態不再錯留成 `unresolved`。

Workflow 子代理在完成幾次模型呼叫後才失敗，那些已完成的呼叫所消耗的 token 現在照樣計入 Workflow 的 token 總數，並從你設的 token 預算裡扣除。
body.en:
Issues commonly seen when running multiple Workflows—stopped checkpoint saving, hung agents, and uncounted tokens—have been fixed in this release.

Once a Workflow ends, its finished subagents are removed from the saved session instead of being carried into every subsequent checkpoint, so long sessions running many Workflows no longer stop saving checkpoints.

An unresponsive Workflow agent or Auto-review reviewer is forcefully terminated 30 seconds after cancellation instead of hanging indefinitely.

Stopping a Workflow right as it is about to finish no longer leaves its status stuck as `unresolved`.

When a Workflow subagent fails after completing several model calls, the tokens used by those completed calls still count toward the Workflow's token total and are deducted from your configured token budget.

items.original:
Long sessions that run many Workflows no longer stop saving checkpoints: once a Workflow has ended, its finished subagents drop out of the saved session instead of being carried in every later checkpoint
A Workflow agent or an Auto-review reviewer that has stopped responding is now ended 30 seconds after it is cancelled, instead of staying open indefinitely
Stopping a Workflow at the moment it finishes no longer leaves it shown as `unresolved`
When a Workflow subagent's run fails after it has completed model calls, the tokens of those completed calls now count in the Workflow's token total and against a token budget you set

title.zh-TW: 設有 hook 時中止工具呼叫的狀態更準確
title.en: More accurate status when stopping tool calls with hooks configured

body.zh-TW:
已設定 `PreToolUse` hook 時，若在工具呼叫即將開始前中止執行或子代理，現在會以已取消結束，不再報錯「tool batch ended without result」。

同一批若有多個工具呼叫被 hook 中止，其中某個呼叫經 `PostToolUseFailure` hook 以 `updatedInput` 修正後也觸發中止。現在它的中止原因不會再覆蓋掉較早那次呼叫的中止原因。⟦跟餐廳臨時撤單一樣，櫃台會註記為已取消而非出餐失敗，後面幾道菜的退單理由也不會蓋掉最先喊停的那一張。⟧
body.en:
When a `PreToolUse` hook is configured, stopping a run or subagent just before its tool calls start now ends it as cancelled instead of failing with the error "tool batch ended without result".

If multiple tool calls in the same batch are stopped by hooks, and one of those calls also triggers a stop after a `PostToolUseFailure` hook corrects it with `updatedInput`, its stop reason no longer overwrites the stop reason of the earlier call. ⟦At a restaurant when an order is canceled unexpectedly, the counter marks it as cancelled rather than a failed dish, and the cancellation reasons for later dishes do not overwrite the first one that called a halt.⟧

items.original:
Stopping a run or subagent just before its tool calls start, with a `PreToolUse` hook configured, now ends it as cancelled instead of failed with "tool batch ended without result"
When hooks stop a turn on more than one tool call of a batch, a stop on a call that a `PostToolUseFailure` hook corrected with `updatedInput` no longer replaces the stop reason of an earlier call

title.zh-TW: 無實質改動的 hook 不再寫進工作階段紀錄
title.en: Hooks making no substantive changes no longer write to the session log

body.zh-TW:
來自設定檔或 hooks 檔的 hook，會在工作階段啟動、接續、清除、壓縮或分支時觸發。如果它以 0 退出、標準錯誤只有空白，且沒有新增或修改任何上下文、系統訊息或錯誤，就不會寫進工作階段紀錄。其他情況和外掛 hook 在這些事件執行時都在結束後照舊紀錄。若這類事件或子代理啟動時把純文字印到標準輸出，因為會成為上下文，所以同樣會留下記錄。

`Stop` hook 同樣以退出碼 0 結束、標準錯誤只有空白，而且沒讓該輪繼續、沒加系統訊息也沒失敗時，不會留下記錄。其餘執行結果則在結束時照常寫進紀錄。⟦就像巡邏員繞了一圈回報一切正常且沒留便條，值班簿便不再多記一筆，只有真的出狀況或交辦事項時才寫上去。⟧
body.en:
A hook from a settings or hooks file triggers when a session starts, resumes, clears, compacts, or forks. If it exits with 0, writes only whitespace to standard error, and adds or modifies no context, system message, or error, it is not written to the session log. Other runs and plugin hooks executing on these events are still recorded as before after they finish. If plain text is printed to standard output during these events or when a subagent starts, it becomes context and is therefore still recorded.

Similarly, a `Stop` hook leaves no record if it finishes with exit code 0, writes only whitespace to standard error, does not keep the turn going, adds no system message, and does not fail. All other execution results are written to the log as usual when they finish. ⟦A patrol guard who finishes a round, reports everything is fine, and leaves no note does not get an extra entry in the duty logbook; only actual incidents or handoff items are written down.⟧

items.original:
A hook from a settings or hooks file that runs when a session starts, resumes, clears, compacts or forks no longer leaves a record in the session log when it exits 0, writes nothing but whitespace to stderr and adds or changes nothing (no context, system message or error); any other run of these hooks is recorded when it ends, and runs of a plugin's hook at these events are recorded as before; plain text that a hook prints to stdout when a session starts, resumes, clears, compacts or forks, or when a subagent starts, becomes context, so that run is recorded
A `Stop` hook no longer leaves a record in the session log when it exits 0, writes nothing but whitespace to stderr and adds or changes nothing (it does not keep the turn going, add a system message or fail); any other run of a `Stop` hook is recorded when it ends

title.zh-TW: Windows 輸入符號與檔案索引等問題修復
title.en: Fixes for Windows symbol input, session indexing, and related issues

body.zh-TW:
Windows 使用者在輸入框打特殊符號、開啟 `/resume` 或建立專案副本，過去容易碰上各種卡關。

在輸入框打字或貼上內容時，`✓`、`→`、`€`、`—` 等符號、組合重音符號，以及表情符號的連接與變體選擇字元不會再漏字。

損毀的工作階段索引檔現在會先挪到一旁並從工作階段紀錄重建，開 `/resume` 不必每次重掃所有已存紀錄，也不用自己手動刪檔。

使用 `--worktree create` 建立工作階段的 worktree（讓同一個專案平行開出多份副本的功能）時，不再因為 Git 寫入 `.git` 檔失敗而中斷。

代理誤把資料夾當成檔案讀時，畫面指給它改用的列出指令現在能正確處理含空白、引號或非 ASCII 字元的資料夾名稱。
body.en:
Windows users previously ran into various snags when typing special symbols in the composer, opening `/resume`, or creating project copies.

When typing or pasting into the composer, symbols such as `✓`, `→`, `€`, and `—`, combining accents, emoji joiners, and variation selectors are no longer dropped.

A corrupt session index file is now set aside and rebuilt from the session logs, so opening `/resume` no longer rescans every saved log each time, and you do not have to delete the file manually.

Creating a session worktree (a feature for opening multiple parallel copies of the same project) with `--worktree create` no longer aborts because Git fails to write the `.git` file.

When the agent mistakenly tries to read a folder as a file, the listing command it is pointed to now handles folder names containing spaces, quotes, or non-ASCII characters properly.

items.original:

title.zh-TW: 終端機畫面與按鍵反應卡頓問題修復
title.en: Fixes for terminal display freezes and key responsiveness issues

body.zh-TW:
快速連按快捷鍵或在忙碌的電腦上執行長對話時，操作體驗現在更順暢，不再突然凍結或顯示重複文字。

長工作階段剛送出提示就立刻按 `Esc`，同一段提示不再同時出現在輸入框和狀態列上方。

重新映射指令觸發鍵後，排隊鍵現在仍會保留原本的指令意圖，因此在執行中途按下重設後的離開或清除操作，會直接當作指令執行，不會把文字放進排隊。

在等待工作階段紀錄寫入慢速硬碟以檢查子代理工作區期間，終端機介面不會再停止讀取按鍵或重繪畫面，在忙碌的機器上跑對話或子代理時不會再卡住畫面。
body.en:
Pressing shortcuts in quick succession or running long conversations on a busy machine is now smoother, without sudden freezes or duplicate text.

Pressing `Esc` right after sending a prompt in a long session no longer displays the same prompt in both the composer and above the status row.

After remapping the command trigger key, the queue key now preserves the original command intent, so pressing the remapped exit or clear action mid-run executes it directly as a command instead of queueing its text.

While waiting for a session log to write to a slow disk for the subagent workspace check, the terminal interface no longer stops reading keystrokes or redrawing the screen, preventing freezes when running conversations or subagents on a busy machine.

title.zh-TW: 背景指令通知與任務異常中止處理修正

A turn waiting on a monitor or background task no longer wakes for an update the model already received

Preserve exit status and output in notifications for long background commands

title.zh-TW: 串流標頭遺漏與過載重試等待機制改善
title.en: Improved handling of missing streaming headers and overload retry waits

body.zh-TW:
串流端點回應如果完全沒有 `Content-Type` 標頭，現在會先短暫重試再失敗，以應對代理伺服器暫時改寫標頭的狀況。至於明確標註為非 SSE 類型的頁面，仍會立刻判定失敗。

遇到模型服務回傳 HTTP 503 過載或 HTTP 504 逾時時，第一次重試與伺服器未指定時間的重試等待，現在會在各工作階段間錯開一點。這能減少許多工作階段同時重試、一起擠向原本就忙碌的服務。⟦跟尖峰時段電話佔線時，大家各自等幾秒再錯開重撥一樣，才不會同一瞬間全擠進總機把線路塞爆。⟧
body.en:
If a streaming endpoint responds with no `Content-Type` header at all, it now retries briefly before failing to handle cases where a proxy temporarily rewrites the header. Pages explicitly labeled as a non-SSE type still fail immediately.

When the model service returns an HTTP 503 overload or HTTP 504 timeout, the first retry and any retry wait not specified by the server are now staggered slightly across sessions. This reduces the chance of many sessions retrying simultaneously and piling onto an already busy service. ⟦Like callers facing a busy line during peak hours, everyone waits a few seconds and staggers their redials so they do not flood the switchboard all at once.⟧

items.original:
When a streaming endpoint answers with no Content-Type header at all, the run now keeps retrying briefly before failing, matching how a transitory proxy rewrite of the header behaves; a page explicitly labelled with a non-SSE content type still fails at once
When the model service is overloaded (HTTP 503) or times out (HTTP 504), the first retry, and any retry wait the server does not set, now varies a little between sessions, so fewer sessions retry at the same moment and pile onto a service that is already busy

first_title.zh-TW: 壓縮摘要共用快取並保留你的提問
first_title.en: Compaction summaries share cache and keep your prompts

entries: **New panel theme: Plush Pals.** Cream cards with a brown stitched rim, and eleven original plush animals that stroll along a row under the cards. One pal sits on each quota bar at its current percentage; it looks worried from 80% and falls asleep when the quota runs out (whichever of the 5-hour and weekly quotas is closer to the limit), and wakes up cheering when it resets. The pals speak up only when it matters, one speech bubble at a time: when a quota reaches 80%, runs out or resets; when a sleeping pal's quota is about 10 minutes from resetting (it stretches); when the current pace would empty a quota early (saying how long is left, and which other tool still has room); when Claude or Codex reports an outage and when it recovers; when today's usage passes yesterday's (the line cheers); on the day's first visit, with a greeting that fits (a weekly quota that just reset, a return after a few days, Monday or Friday, or the time of day); and after midnight. Now and then two pals in line chat or one dozes off. In December snow falls across the panel and a felt Christmas tree, a different one each day, stands at its end. Click a pal to see its name. Pick it from **⚙ Settings → Switch Panel**; there are now 18 themes. The panel always uses its light look, whatever the system appearance.

**Beginner Mode lets you mark terms one at a time and skips project names.** Press 4–6 to mark a single term understood; 9 still marks all three. Branch names, PR numbers, file names, paths and bare numbers no longer take the three hint slots, and every hint must appear in Claude's answer.

**Beginner Mode treats two names for one idea as one term.** Once you mark "分支（branch）" or "PR（Pull Request）" understood, "branch", "分支", "PR" and "pull request" stop appearing as new hints, and typing either name counts as knowing it.

**Beginner Mode loses fewer "understood" marks when two conversations save at once.** Each change now re-reads the term list right before saving. It also stops asking Haiku for terms while the term list is unreadable, and the 5-hour pause now follows that quota's own reading time and reset.

**Beginner Mode explanations are no longer cut off mid-sentence.** Haiku is asked for a complete short phrase, and the length limit doubles to 80 characters. An explanation saved half-finished is replaced the next time its term comes up.

**Beginner Mode hints only what the answer really uses.** A term learned under one name no longer comes back under its other name, whichever came first. `API` no longer counts as appearing just because the answer says `RAPID`. PR numbers like `PR #42`, Windows paths and branch names such as `fix/test` no longer take hint slots, and one malformed term after a line of preamble no longer drops the others. title.zh-TW: 新手模式選詞更準並可單獨標懂名詞
title.en: Beginner Mode Picks Better Terms and Marks Them One by One

body.zh-TW:
用新手模式學名詞，以前只懂一兩個詞卻得按 9 全標，還常被無關的檔名或路徑佔掉三個提示位置。現在按 4～6 就能單獨標懂對應的那一個名詞，按 9 照舊三個一起標。分支名稱、檔名、路徑、單獨數字與 PR（請求把修改併回主線）編號不再佔位，每個提示也都會真的出現在 Claude 的回答裡。

title.zh-TW: 新手模式紀錄保存與提示比對更可靠
title.en: Beginner Mode Saves Progress and Matches Hints More Reliably

body.zh-TW:
多視窗存檔打架與解答斷句這類新手模式的小狀況，現在都有解了。

兩個對話同時存檔時，每次改動都在存檔前一刻重讀名詞紀錄，較不會弄丟「懂了」。紀錄讀不到時不再先請 Haiku 挑詞，5 小時額度的暫停改看該額度自己的讀取與重置時間。

白話解釋改請 Haiku 寫出完整短句，長度上限加倍到 80 個字元，不再被切成半句。之前存成半句的解釋，下次那個詞再出現時會換成完整版。

用一種寫法學會的詞，不論先遇到哪種寫法，換另一種都不會再回來。回答只有 `RAPID` 字樣時不再算出現 `API`，`PR #42`、Windows 路徑與 `fix/test` 分支名也不再佔位。Haiku 在清單前多寫一句話時，缺欄位的單一詞彙不再連累其他詞消失，每則回答讀名詞紀錄的次數也變少。

現在多視窗並行時，標記較不易漏存、解釋看得到整句，提示也只留回答真正用到的詞。

Small Beginner Mode hiccups like competing window saves and cut-off explanations are now fixed.

When two conversations save at once, each change re-reads the term list right before saving so "understood" marks are less likely to be lost. When the list is unreadable, it no longer asks Haiku for terms first, and the 5-hour quota pause now follows that quota's own reading and reset times.

Plain-language explanations now ask Haiku for a complete short sentence, and the length limit doubles to 80 characters so they are no longer cut in half. Any explanation saved half-finished is replaced with the full version the next time that term appears.

A term learned under one spelling never comes back under the other, whichever you saw first. Replies containing only `RAPID` no longer count as showing `API`, and `PR #42`, Windows paths, and `fix/test` branch names no longer take up slots. When Haiku adds a line of preamble before the list, a single term with a missing field no longer causes the other terms to disappear, and each reply reads the term list fewer times.

Now when multiple windows run in parallel, marks are less likely to drop, explanations show full sentences, and hints keep only the terms the reply actually uses.

body.zh-TW:
清理不再維護的 GitHub 儲存庫，不少人習慣在 `gh repo delete` 後面補上 `--yes` 直接跳過確認。現在要刪的如果是私有或內部儲存庫，而且會一併刪掉底下的 fork（從原儲存庫另外複製出去的獨立副本），指令就會先跳出警告。這時你得再確認一次，就算已經加上 `--yes` 也一樣。

如果是沒有人手輸入的非互動式流程或代理程式，執行刪除就必須明確加上同意連帶刪除的參數：

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦就像管理員要關掉大樓的總電源，以前只要拿到授權單就直接斷電，現在發現線路還接著其他人的設備，就會先暫停並要求再確認，連自動排程也得另外寫明同意一併斷電。⟧
body.en:
When cleaning up unmaintained GitHub repositories, many people add `--yes` after `gh repo delete` to skip confirmation. Now, if the repository you are deleting is private or internal and will also delete its forks (independent copies made from the original repository), the command warns you first. You then have to confirm a second time, even if you already passed `--yes`.

For non-interactive workflows or agents without manual input, running the deletion requires explicitly adding the flag that accepts cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦Picture a building manager shutting off the main power: previously, an authorization slip was enough to cut it right away, but now if the lines still feed other people's equipment, the process pauses for a second confirmation—and even automated schedules must separately state they agree to cut power to those as well.⟧
